Even he couldn’t help raising an eyebrow.
"Nyx’s speed." A faint smile appeared beneath his helmet.
"Really is something."
Although he had spent thousands of hours training inside time chamber.
Most of that time had been devoted to mastering Caelith’s Titan Form.
Compared to it.
His experience using Nyx was surprisingly limited.
Yet after witnessing this battle.
He finally understood something.
Nyx wasn’t merely powerful.
He was absurd.
Luke silently replayed the scene in his mind.
"Interesting."
Then he recalled something Nyx had once told him.
The Faceless Titan—Myrkhal.
Could only perfectly replicate Titan Forms possessing Greater Bloodlines.
Or anything below that level.
That was exactly what Nyx had explained back then.
He also had said one interesting thing.
"If Myrkhal is hiding other forms, then even we don’t know."
At the time Luke hadn’t understood what he meant.
But now he did.
"The real Titan Forms." He quietly muttered those words.
Nyx.
Caelith.
Myrkhal.
The real tittan, the source from which countless lower-bloodline Titans had descended.
Which also meant every aspect of them had reached its absolute peak.
Strength.
Speed.
Defense.
Vitality.
Control.
Everything.
Far beyond any ordinary Titan possessing a Greater Bloodline or lower.
Luke slowly pieced together the realization.
"So that’s what he meant." A thoughtful smile appeared on his face.
Take the Void Titan—Nyx, for example.
His greatest authority undoubtedly lay in controlling the Void.
That was his true specialty.
However that didn’t mean the rest of his abilities were lacking.
On the contrary even in terms of pure physical strength.
Or raw movement speed.
Nyx could still overwhelm a lower-bloodline Titan whose entire specialty was strength or speed.
That realization had shocked Luke when Nyx first explained it.
Which suprised him.
As he rarely used Nyx for direct frontal combat.
Most of the time he transformed into Myrkhal, relying on its adaptability and available forms.
Because of that. he had never truly experienced what a True Titan was capable of physically.
Even The cosmic heart titan.
He used cosmic system strength, rather than his own pysical strength.
But today’s battle, had changed that.
"Though even among the True Titans.
Nyx’s speed should stand at the very peak."
After all unlike ordinary movement.
He didn’t simply run.
He seemed to use the Void itself as a pathway.
Luke could vaguely sense it.
Only vaguely.
His current realm was still far too low to truly comprehend the mysteries of the Void.
It was like staring into an endless abyss through a tiny crack.
He could see that something incredible existed.
But not grasp it.
Not yet.
Luke slowly clenched his fist.
The Void energy around it rippled quietly.
"One day." A faint smile appeared beneath his helmet.
"I’ll understand the Void completely."
"And when that day comes."
His eyes shone with quiet determination, "I’ll finally witness the true power of Nyx."
After dealing with the bandits.
Luke’s gaze swept across every campsite through the eyes of his dopplegängers.
Scattered everywhere were piles of stolen goods.
Wooden crates.
Sacks of grain.
Barrels of wine.
Weapons.
Armor.
Even bags filled with gold and silver coins.
It was obvious these had all been robbed from unfortunate caravans.
Then his turn his gaze toward far distance.
Several figures could be seen tied to nearby trees and wooden posts.
Some had bruises.
Others looked pale from hunger.
A few had already lost all hope.
The moment the prisoners noticed the black-blue armored figure approaching.
Their bodies instinctively trembled.
"W-Who-" Before anyone could finish speaking.
Slash!
The ropes binding them were cleanly severed.
One after another the captives hurriedly freed themselves.
Luke’s calm voice soon followed.
"The bandits are dead."
"The road ahead is safe now."
He glanced toward the piles of supplies.
"Take whatever belongs to you."
"If there are items without owners.
You may divide them among yourselves."

chapters.title: Chapter 182: The Hidden Observer
paragraphs: For a brief moment. The prisoners simply stood there in disbelief.
Then one elderly merchant suddenly fell to his knees.
"T-Thank you, Sir!"
A young woman hurriedly bowed as tears welled up in her eyes.
"You saved our lives."
"We’ll never forget this kindness."
Soon one after another.
Everyone bowed deeply toward the silent armored knight.
"Thank you!"
"We’ll always be grateful!"
"You truly are our hero!"
They thanked him again and again. Because he didn’t only save them, But now he was also allowing them to take the loot, which was so generous. That they thought they had find an Hero.
Which was typically right.
About the hero part, but not the loot part.
"Damn it, I didn’t bring spatial rings with me." Luke cursed, because he only have one large ring with him, which he got from Early golden knight assassin and others are in territory treasure.
So his dopplenger could only kill, but not loot...
’wait that’s sound wrong. But who cares.’
Luke shook his head before letting out a small chuckle.
Below the freed prisoners happily walked along the road.
Some carried sacks of grain. Others held bags of coins.
Several merchants even pushed recovered carts filled with goods.
Their exhausted faces had long been replaced with relieved smiles.
"Haha! We survived!"
"My wife will be so happy."
"We can finally go home."
One elderly merchant wiped away the tears in his eyes.
Luke quietly watched them disappear into the distance.
A faint smile appeared beneath his helmet.
"Well."
"I’m already rich."
"So it’s fine."
He wasn’t lying. Compared to the wealth stored inside Blackstone’s treasury. These bandit camps were insignificant.
With that thought. He mentally issued another command.
"Continue the mission."
Instantly.
All ten dopplegängers acknowledged the order.
Each clone began constructing its assigned watchtower.
Before moving on to clear every remaining bandit camp nearby.
Luke had deliberately selected each construction site with care.
Not directly beside the main road.
Instead.
A short distance inside the surrounding forest.
Far enough to remain concealed. Yet close enough to monitor the road perfectly.
That way the stationed soldiers could observe caravans without exposing themselves too easily.
If enemies attempted an ambush. The guards inside the towers would often notice them first.
Combined with the towers five-kilometer detection range.
Every section of the trade route would eventually overlap with the next.
Leaving almost no blind spots.
"A continuous surveillance network."
Luke nodded in satisfaction. Exactly as he had envisioned.
While his ten dopplegängers busied themselves with the hard labor.
He looked down and listened to the gossip of two peak silver rank knight people.
Yes, when he teleported, he appeared above them on the tree branch, while they were hiding on the below tree branches.
And were looking toward the Blackstone Territory through telescope-like light artifacts, allowing them to clearly observe every movement within the territory.
Surprisingly.
Not a single one of them heard anything.
Not even when Luke cursed loudly.
All thanks to Null Veil of Nyx.
"Absolute Stealth." Luke nodded in satisfaction, the corners of his lips curling upward into a pleased smile.
Then.
That smile slowly faded.
Instead, his brows furrowed, while a hint of annoyance flashed across his face.
The reason?
"It seems quite a few forces are spying on my territory."
He paused for a brief second. His sharp blue eyes narrowed.
"Or"
"At me."
Luke slowly swept his gaze across the surroundings.
Left. Right.
Then farther into the distance.
Soon enough, more figures entered his vision.
One. Three. Five. There were quite a few of them.

Each possessing Bronze or Silver Knight cultivation, while holding telescope-like light artifacts in their hands, their eyes fixed on Blackstone Territory as though some grand festival was unfolding before them.
"...Seriously?" Luke let out a helpless sigh before clicking his tongue.
"Don’t these people have anything better to do?" He couldn’t help but curse under his breath.

From what he could tell, the surrounding Baron Territories had dispatched their people solely to monitor his every movement, likely fearing that he would suddenly march his army over and seize their lands.
Which Luke was both right and wrong.
Yes, there were people from the surrounding Baron Territories.
However there were even more observers from the Viscount Territories.
The reason was simple.
The news of Viscount Aldaric—a Mid-Golden Knight—mysteriously disappearing had spread across the region that very night.
The moment they heard it. Every Viscount’s heart skipped a beat.
They couldn’t help but recall the massive explosion that had occurred beside Windmarch Reach.
One coincidence?
Perhaps.
But then another piece of news arrived.
Hero Luke aad killed a Mid-Golden Knight with a single punch.
Not only that—
He had also dealt with four Early Golden Knights with astonishing ease.
"Impossible."
That was the first thought that crossed almost everyone’s mind.
Yet the reports came from multiple sources.
Which was exactly why they couldn’t simply ignore them.
As a result not a single Viscount managed to sleep peacefully that night.
Some paced around their rooms.
Others immediately summoned intelligence officers.
While many secretly dispatched scouts toward Blackstone Territory, wanting to verify the truth with their own eyes.
Naturally Luke became the center of everyone’s suspicion.
However the more they compared the information they had gathered. The more confused they became.
First.
Luke had remained inside the fortress the entire time. Many people had personally witnessed it.
Logically speaking, there was no way he could have traveled all the way back to the Viscount Territory in such a short time.
Unless...
He possessed some incredibly fast movement artifact.
Second.
According to every report, the battle near Windmarch Reach had lasted for quite some time.
However at the very end of the fight—
A terrifying explosion erupted.
Its power had already reached the Peak Golden Knight level.
And that was exactly where the contradiction lay.
Because no matter how talented Hero Luke was.
He simply shouldn’t have possessed that level of destructive power.
Then another piece of information surfaced.
Luke had the ability to create clones.

chapters.title: Chapter 183: The Alliance of Viscounts
paragraphs: An ability he had already displayed during the Count’s daughter’s dance party.
The moment that news spread, everyone’s perspective changed.
"A clone?"
"If that’s true."
"Then everything makes sense."
Some couldn’t help but gasp. Others exchanged solemn glances.
Suddenly the impossible no longer seemed so impossible.
This was also one of the reasons Luke had never wanted to expose too many of his trump cards.
After all.
Even his cloning ability was supposed to remain hidden.
There was still one fact that no one could wrap their heads around.
An Early Bronze Knight possessing the combat power of peak-golden knight?.
If it hadn’t been exposed. Luke could have continued using it as a cover for a much longer time.
At least until he had grown even stronger.
But.
What was done was done. There was no changing it now.
Then, another detail caught everyone’s attention.
When the Golden Knight launched his attack on the fortress where Luke was supposedly staying. Luke had mysteriously disappeared.
And when they matched the timing.
They discovered that Luke had reappeared on the battlefield shortly after that terrifying explosion.
The pieces slowly fell into place.
"It really was Hero Luke."
One by one they became convinced that Hero Luke was the one who had killed Viscount Aldaric.
After all he had more than enough motive.
The hatred between the two sides had already reached the point of no return.
Not only that Aldaric had even hired an assassination organization to eliminate Luke.
From every angle Luke had the strongest reason to seek revenge.
Sadly.
Reason alone wasn’t enough.
There wasn’t a single piece of concrete evidence.
No one had actually seen Luke at the battlefield where Aldaric was killed.
Even his Sylvarion form had remained high in the sky during that period, making it impossible for anyone to confirm his whereabouts.
Without any witnesses, evidence and proof.
They couldn’t accuse Hero Luke of murdering Viscount Aldaric.
After all he was both a noble and a Hero.
"Do you think Baron Luke really killed the Viscount?"
One of the men hiding beneath the branches of a towering tree lowered his telescope-like light artifact and quietly asked his companion.
Hearing those words. Luke was momentarily startled.
’Hm?’
’They actually guessed it was me?’
A baffled expression flashed across his face.
Curiosity getting the better of him, he remained silent and continued listening to their conversation.
Soon enough he understood everything.
"So that’s how they connected the dots."
Luke rubbed his chin thoughtfully.
"My strength."
He couldn’t help but shake his head before silently listening to their gossip once again.
"Then are we really not going to make a move against him?" the same man asked hesitantly.
He had dark brown hair and was wrapped from neck to toe in a loose brown robe, with only his eyes visible.
His companion, whose black hair carried faint brown streaks, glanced around cautiously before replying in a wary tone.
"We still don’t know Baron Luke’s true strength."
He paused for a brief moment.
"So taking such a risk would be foolish."
Hearing that.
Luke nodded repeatedly with an approving smile.
"Good boy."
He was just about to withdraw his gaze.
However the other man seemed unwilling to let the matter end there.
A strange itch stirred within him.
As if he desperately wanted to provoke Luke.
"But didn’t you hear? Viscount Aldaric left his own territory like a fool."
"Besides he was only a newly risen Viscount."
"Our families have held our territories for far longer than his."
He folded his arms proudly, a smug grin spreading across his face.
"And I’m certain Luke wouldn’t dare attack our territory like he did Aldaric’s."
"Our army is stronger."
"Our defenses are stronger."
"The moment he sees our fortress. He’ll tuck his tail between his legs and run away like a chicken."
Luke’s mouth twitched violently.
The vein on his forehead almost bulged.
"Kid."
He took a slow, deep breath to suppress the urge to march over there immediately.
"Just wait until the Arcane Sky Tower finishes charging."
A dangerous smile slowly crept across his lips.
"Then I’ll personally rain a hundred bolts of lightning on your territory."
"Especially your house."
He muttered through gritted teeth, his eye twitching in irritation.
The second man instantly frowned and smacked the back of his companion’s head.
*Smack!*
"Idiot.
"If things were really that simple." He shot him an exasperated glare.
"Do you honestly think the other Viscounts would’ve just sat back and done nothing?"
"They would’ve attacked him long ago."
The black-haired man immediately rebuked him.
Hearing those words. The brown-haired man’s smug expression instantly stiffened.
His face fell.
He quietly lowered his head, no longer daring to speak.
Luke, on the other hand. Nearly teared up in joy.
His eyes actually became a little moist.
"Why can’t everyone be as intelligent as him?"
He muttered emotionally while looking at the black-haired man with newfound appreciation.
"Finally. Someone with a brain."
Then.
The black-haired man continued.
"And besides if this had happened before. We could’ve done something."
"In the worst-case scenario. We could’ve even formed an alliance with the other Viscount Territories."
The instant those words entered Luke’s ears.
His smile froze.
The corners of his lips slowly twitched downward.
His earlier excitement vanished without a trace.
"Nah." He sighed.
"I take it back."
"He is not idiot."
"He is actually pretty smart."
Luke rubbed his forehead with a helpless expression.
It seemed these people had already considered every possible solution.
If Blackstone had truly become a threat before. Several long-established Viscount families could have temporarily joined forces.
After all those Viscount Houses had ruled their territories for generations.
Their foundations were far deeper than Aldaric’s ever had been.
Each possessed multiple Golden Knights. Some even had hidden trump cards.
If several such families genuinely united. Even Luke would find the situation troublesome.
Not impossible. But definitely troublesome.
He narrowed his glowing eyes.
"Then."
"Why did he emphasize ’before’?" A trace of confusion surfaced on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: The Saintess’s Smile And System Advice
paragraphs: His brows slowly furrowed.
He quietly repeated it in his mind.
"Before."
"Before what?"
As if hearing Luke’s unspoken question.
The black-haired man unknowingly answered it himself.
"Didn’t you notice?" The black-haired man looked at his companion before lowering his voice.
"The Holy Church’s Templar Knights have been destroying one Hidden Hand base after another."
The moment those words were spoken. The brown-haired man’s face instantly turned pale.
His pupils shrank.
"W-What?!" His voice trembled slightly.
"T-The Templar Knights?"
A drop of cold sweat slid down his forehead.
Unlike ordinary people. He knew exactly what those fanatics were capable of.
Those lunatics were monsters who hunted heretics without mercy.
Seeing his horrified expression. The black-haired man simply nodded.
His own face was equally serious.
"I know."
"Even I’m afraid of those people."
"They don’t negotiate."
"They don’t accept surrender."
"And once they set their eyes on a target."
He paused for a moment before saying in a heavy voice,
"they won’t stop until it’s completely erased."
A brief silence followed.
Even the surrounding leaves seemed quieter.
Meanwhile...
Luke blinked in confusion.
"Templar Knights?"
"The Holy Church?" His expression became rather strange.
"Isn’t that the same church that summoned me?" Memories from long ago surfaced in his mind.
The grand cathedral. The holy ceremony. Thousands of gazes fixed upon him.
And...
A breathtakingly beautiful Saintess standing before everyone.
Luke rubbed his chin.
"Then she announced to everyone that I was talentless." He sighed dramatically.
"Basically she rejected me in public."
A moment later, he scratched his cheek awkwardly.
"Okay."
"I might’ve exaggerated that part."
"It wasn’t really a rejection."
"She simply announced the test result."
After a brief pause. He nodded to himself with complete seriousness.
"But still."
"She was definitely a rare beauty."
The moment that thought appeared—
A familiar System window silently popped into existence.
Luke glanced at it.
Then.
Without even waiting for it to say anything.
He immediately raised a hand.
"No."
"I already know what you’re about to say."
"...And no."
The System remained silent for a moment.
Then continued, as he had absolutely no intention of stopping.
Another screen immediately popped up.
[Luke how can a Hero’s story be complete without a Saintess? (¬‿¬)]
Luke’s eyelid twitched.
"Here we go again."
The System completely ignored him.
[Did you forget the stories from your world?]

chapters.title: Chapter 185: The Unseen Protector
paragraphs: "There are other forces involved." His eyes instinctively scanned the surroundings before he continued.
"And they’re backing Hero Luke from the shadows."
A trace of fear flashed across his face.
The brown-haired man frowned.
"Why?" His confusion was obvious.
Luke, who was listening from above, subconsciously nodded as well.
"Yeah..."
"Why?" He quietly muttered.
"What made you think that?" Almost immediately.
The black-haired man answered.
"I recently heard some news." He swallowed unconsciously before speaking.
"One of the Hidden Hand’s assassination branches."
He paused.
"was wiped out."
The brown-haired man’s pupils contracted.
"Wiped out?"
The black-haired man nodded heavily.
"Completely."
"Silently."
"In the dead of night."
His voice became increasingly solemn.
"Everyone inside was killed."
A cold breeze swept through the forest.
Even Luke narrowed his eyes.
"The strangest part. There wasn’t a single trace left behind."
"No witnesses."
"No clues."
"No signs of battle."
"No evidence whatsoever pointing toward the killer."
As he spoke his face gradually turned pale.
Because he knew exactly what kind of place that had been.
"I gave commissions to that assassination branch several times before."
"It wasn’t some small hideout."
"It was one of their large operational bases."
"The people stationed there weren’t weak."
"They couldn’t have been eliminated without making even the slightest commotion."
"Yet they were."
Silence descended between the two men. Even the brown-haired man’s breathing became heavier.
After thinking for a while. He hesitantly spoke.
"Maybe."
"It was the Holy Church."
"They’ve been hunting the Hidden Hand recently."
"Besides."
"Who else could accomplish something like that?"
His reasoning sounded perfectly logical.
However.
The black-haired man immediately shook his head.
"No."
"Killing silently." The black-haired man slowly shook his head. "isn’t their style."
The sentence was simple.
Yet both the brown-haired man—
And Luke hiding above—
Were equally stunned.
"So." The brown-haired man swallowed.
"It really wasn’t the Church?"
The black-haired man nodded with absolute certainty.
"I’m willing to bet my life on it."
"The Templar Knights don’t hide in the darkness."
"They bring judgment beneath the sunlight."
"They want fear to spread."
"They want everyone to know. that the Holy Church carried out the execution."
He folded his arms.
"But whoever destroyed that Hidden Hand base. wanted the exact opposite."
A chill ran down the brown-haired man’s spine.
Meanwhile.
Luke also became thoughtful.
"Who is helping me?" He quietly muttered to himself.
His mind immediately began recalling every person he knew.
Aurielle? Impossible.
She had been with him.
Osric? No. He lacked that kind of strength.
Margaret?
No chance.
The Arcane Sky Tower?
It couldn’t move by itself.
Soon.
The conversation below finally came to an end.
The two Silver Knights packed away their telescope artifact before preparing to leave.
Luke’s smile gradually faded. His eyes slowly turned cold.
"So there are this many rats inside my territory already."
His quiet voice carried a trace of killing intent.
If he hadn’t happened to be here today.
If he hadn’t overheard their conversation.
He would’ve remained completely unaware that spies had already infiltrated Blackstone.
That realization alone was enough to make his expression darken.
Luke slowly looked toward the distant Blackstone Territory.
"I can’t watch every corner." He muttered with slight frustration.
No matter how powerful he became. It was impossible for one person to guard an entire territory twenty-four hours a day.
Especially one whose trade routes stretched for nearly a thousand kilometers.
Completely sealing every information leak was far easier said than done.
"Looks like."
"I’ll have to build a proper intelligence network as well.
A new thought quietly formed in his mind.
After all.
The best way to deal with rats wasn’t merely killing the ones you found.
It was discovering the nest they came from.
Even though entering Blackstone Highlands through the main trade road was almost impossible without being noticed.
After all.
The entire region was naturally protected by the Stormhowl Mountains.
Their lower slopes were blanketed by dense ancient forests.
Those forests weren’t ordinary. They housed thousands of magical beasts.
Ferocious monsters. Poisonous creatures.
And predators capable of hunting entire caravans.
For ordinary people crossing those woods was practically suicide.
However for Bronze Knights and especially Silver Knights. The danger was far less severe.
As long as they avoided venturing too deep. Or climbing toward the mountain peaks and central regions.
They could still move through the forest without much difficulty.
Luke narrowed his eyes. The real problem lay elsewhere.
Blackstone only controlled the first one hundred kilometers of the thousand-kilometer trade route.
Beyond that. The forests continued uninterrupted.
Large stretches of unmanaged woodland still existed.
From there experienced scouts could quietly approach the territory.
Although the steep terrain forced them to observe from lower elevations. Making the images unclear...
They could still gather plenty of information.
"The previous natural defenses."
"They’re effective against Bronze Knights."
He paused briefly. "And somewhat effective against Silver Knights."
"But." His expression gradually became solemn.
"For Golden Knights Blackstone’s natural barriers are almost meaningless."
Golden Knights were monsters. They weren’t bound by ordinary terrain.
A single leap allowed them to cross cliffs. One sword strike could split enormous boulders.
At higher levels they could even shatter mountains themselves.
Luke silently looked toward the distant mountain range.
His eyes flickered thoughtfully.
"This is one of Blackstone’s greatest weaknesses." Which he had being heavily relied on the natural geography of the territory.
Luke wanted to develop Blackstone. He wanted merchants from every kingdom to trade here.
He wanted adventurers to settle here. He wanted craftsmen, scholars, mages, and talented people to flock toward his territory.
But that prosperity came with a price.
The more famous Blackstone became. The more enemies it would attract.
Especially those already standing at the Golden Knight Realm.
Such people could simply arrive at his doorstep whenever they wished.
That thought didn’t sit well with Luke.
Next moment his eyes slowly narrowed. "At least the Watchtowers will keep these sneaky rats away for a while."
He quietly muttered.
"Until..."
"I find the perfect cure for them."
A faint cold smile appeared beneath his helmet.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: The Calamity He Brought Upon Himself
paragraphs: He slowly lowered his gaze toward the two hidden Silver Knights.
"Should I kill them?"
He seriously considered it.
After all.
Dead spies couldn’t deliver information. Just as Luke was weighing the pros and cons—
The black-haired man suddenly spoke again.
"It’s fine."
His lips slowly curled into a mocking smile.
"Once the Holy Church calms down. We’ll cut Hero Luke’s wings."
A sinister chuckle escaped his mouth.
"But first he has to survive the calamity he brought upon himself."
"Hahaha." His laughter echoed softly through the forest.
There wasn’t the slightest bit of sympathy in it.
Instead it was filled with undisguised delight.
Ever since Hero Luke had appeared. The Hidden Hand had been thrown into chaos.
Assassination branches were being destroyed one after another.
Many underground organizations had gone completely silent.
Even he could no longer use the assassination network for his own missions.
But.
After hearing the latest news from his lord. His mood immediately improved.
The brown-haired man also grinned. "He deserves it."
He nodded repeatedly. "The faster Hero Luke falls the better it is for our lord."
After all.
Baron Luke’s explosive rise. wasn’t good news for their master’s ambitions.
So the the brown-haired man also joined him in laugh.
"Hahaha!"
The two of them laughed together.
Completely unaware that directly above their heads.
A pair of eyes had already turned ice-cold.
The hesitation had vanished. Only killing intent remained.
Yet.
Neither of them sensed a thing.
Null Veil of Nyx completely concealed Luke’s existence.
Even the suffocating killing intent radiating from him was swallowed by the endless Void.
Luke’s voice echoed silently inside his mind.
"Kill them all."
The command was directed toward his ten dopplegängers.
The next instant—
Far away ten armored figures moved simultaneously.
Void Steps flashed one after another.
Every scout. Every hidden observer. Every infiltrator discovered by the clones. Received the same judgment.
Meanwhile...
Luke himself descended toward the two Silver Knights.
Silently.
Without creating even the slightest ripple in the air.
"I need answers."
"I have to find out who’s targeting me."
His right hand slowly reached toward his waist.
SHING—
Voidfang silently left its sheath.
The dark blade shimmered with faint blue Void runes.
Without hesitation—
Luke disappeared.
SWISH!!
Two flashes of blue-black light crossed the forest.
The next instant. Two severed arms spun through the air.
Thud!
Thud!
They crashed onto the forest floor.
For a heartbeat everything became eerily quiet.
Then—
"AAAAAHHHH!!"
"MY ARM!!"
The agonizing screams of the two Silver Knights echoed throughout the forest.
Blood erupted from both shoulders.
Splash!
Splash!
The surrounding trees were stained crimson.
However those desperate screams never reached anyone else.
Because the remaining scouts hidden throughout the forest.
Were already dead.
Miles away Luke’s dopplegängers had carried out his order flawlessly.
Each scout lost his head before he even realized an enemy had appeared.
A single strike. One clean slash.
Authority of Severance — Physical Severance was imbued into every swing of Voidfang.
Heads rolled silently onto the ground.
Thud. Thud.
Not a single survivor remained.
Back in the forest.
Luke calmly watched the two wounded men. He had deliberately spared them.
For now.
The black-haired man and the brown-haired man staggered backward in horror.
Only now did they realize an enemy stood before them.
Their pupils violently contracted.
"W-When?!"
"H-How did he get here?!"
Neither of them had sensed anything.
It was as though the attacker had materialized from thin air.
Cold sweat instantly drenched their backs.
"An Assassin!"
The horrifying thought flashed through both of their minds simultaneously.
Only an assassin of the same strength or above.
Could approach two Peak Silver Knights without leaving behind the slightest trace.
And Nyx.
Was exactly such a predator.
A being born to hunt from the darkness. Combined with Null Veil of Nyx. The result became utterly terrifying.
The two men hadn’t even realized they were under attack. Until their severed arms landed on the ground.
Clenching their teeth against the unbearable pain. Both hurriedly summoned their weapons into their remaining hands.
Clang!
Steel gleamed beneath the forest canopy.
Their bloodshot eyes immediately locked onto the lone armored figure standing before them.
Even though every fiber of their being wanted to tear the mysterious enemy into pieces.
The black-haired man forced himself to calm down. His sharp eyes narrowed beneath the pain.
"I never sensed him."
His expression gradually became uglier.
He wasn’t an ordinary Silver Knight. He had survived many assassination attempts.
His instincts had saved his life more than once.
Yet not only had he failed to detect the enemy. He hadn’t even sensed the slightest fluctuation before losing his arm.
That alone made his heart sink.
"He’s dangerous."
Very dangerous.
His racing mind immediately began analyzing the situation.
"He didn’t kill us which means. He wants something."
Information.
Interrogation.
Or...
He was wary of the force standing behind them.
Whatever the reason.
The enemy had deliberately kept them alive.
Thinking of that the black-haired man’s eyes flashed.
He immediately tried another approach.
"Do you know who we are?" His voice carried both pain and arrogance.
Blood continued dripping onto the forest floor.
"Do you know..."
"...what will happen if you touch us?"
A naked threat.
He hoped mentioning their background would make the enemy hesitate.
Silence.
The armored figure didn’t answer. Not even a single word.
His face remained completely hidden beneath the dark helmet.
Only those cold, blue eyes silently stared at them through the visor.
The eerie silence. Made both men increasingly uneasy.
The brown-haired man swallowed hard.
"W-Why isn’t he saying anything?" His voice unconsciously trembled.
The black-haired man also felt something was terribly wrong.
Normally an enemy would either negotiate.
Or immediately attack.
This person did neither. He simply watched them.
Like a predator observing two injured prey.
A cold chill crawled up the black-haired man’s spine.
"We have to escape."
Without saying a word. He subtly glanced toward his companion.
Then using only his eyes. He gave a signal.
Run.
The brown-haired man instantly understood.
Years of fighting together allowed them to communicate without words.

Ever since Hero Luke had appeared.
The Hidden Hand had been thrown into chaos.
Assassination branches were being destroyed one after another.
Many underground organizations had gone completely silent.
Even he could no longer use the assassination network for his own missions.
But.
After hearing the latest news from his lord.
His mood immediately improved.
The brown-haired man also grinned.
"He deserves it."
He nodded repeatedly.
"The faster Hero Luke falls the better it is for our lord."
After all.
Baron Luke’s explosive rise. wasn’t good news for their master’s ambitions.
So the the brown-haired man also joined him in laugh.
"Hahaha!"
The two of them laughed together.
Completely unaware that directly above their heads.
A pair of eyes had already turned ice-cold.
The hesitation had vanished.
Only killing intent remained.
Yet.
Neither of them sensed a thing.
Null Veil of Nyx completely concealed Luke’s existence.
Even the suffocating killing intent radiating from him was swallowed by the endless Void.
Luke’s voice echoed silently inside his mind.
"Kill them all."
The command was directed toward his ten dopplegängers.
The next instant—
Far away ten armored figures moved simultaneously.
Void Steps flashed one after another.
Every scout.
Every hidden observer.
Every infiltrator discovered by the clones.
Received the same judgment.
Meanwhile...
Luke himself descended toward the two Silver Knights.
Silently.
Without creating even the slightest ripple in the air.
"I need answers."
"I have to find out who’s targeting me."
His right hand slowly reached toward his waist.
SHING—
Voidfang silently left its sheath.
The dark blade shimmered with faint blue Void runes.
Without hesitation—
Luke disappeared.
SWISH!!
Two flashes of blue-black light crossed the forest.
The next instant.
Two severed arms spun through the air.
Thud!
Thud!
They crashed onto the forest floor.
For a heartbeat everything became eerily quiet.
Then—
"AAAAAHHHH!!"
"MY ARM!!"
The agonizing screams of the two Silver Knights echoed throughout the forest.
Blood erupted from both shoulders.
Splash!
Splash!
The surrounding trees were stained crimson.
However those desperate screams never reached anyone else.
Because the remaining scouts hidden throughout the forest.
Were already dead.
Miles away Luke’s dopplegängers had carried out his order flawlessly.
Each scout lost his head before he even realized an enemy had appeared.
A single strike.
One clean slash.
Authority of Severance — Physical Severance was imbued into every swing of Voidfang.
Heads rolled silently onto the ground.
Thud.
Thud.
Not a single survivor remained.
Back in the forest.
Luke calmly watched the two wounded men.
He had deliberately spared them.
For now.
The black-haired man and the brown-haired man staggered backward in horror.
Only now did they realize an enemy stood before them.
Their pupils violently contracted.
"W-When?!"
"H-How did he get here?!"
Neither of them had sensed anything.
It was as though the attacker had materialized from thin air.
Cold sweat instantly drenched their backs.
"An Assassin!"
The horrifying thought flashed through both of their minds simultaneously.
Only an assassin of the same strength or above.
Could approach two Peak Silver Knights without leaving behind the slightest trace.
And Nyx.
Was exactly such a predator.
A being born to hunt from the darkness.
Combined with Null Veil of Nyx.
The result became utterly terrifying.
The two men hadn’t even realized they were under attack.
Until their severed arms landed on the ground.
Clenching their teeth against the unbearable pain.
Both hurriedly summoned their weapons into their remaining hands.
Clang!
Steel gleamed beneath the forest canopy.
Their bloodshot eyes immediately locked onto the lone armored figure standing before them.
Even though every fiber of their being wanted to tear the mysterious enemy into pieces.
The black-haired man forced himself to calm down.
His sharp eyes narrowed beneath the pain.
"I never sensed him."
His expression gradually became uglier.
He wasn’t an ordinary Silver Knight.
He had survived many assassination attempts.
His instincts had saved his life more than once.
Yet not only had he failed to detect the enemy.
He hadn’t even sensed the slightest fluctuation before losing his arm.
That alone made his heart sink.
"He’s dangerous."
Very dangerous.
His racing mind immediately began analyzing the situation.
"He didn’t kill us which means.
He wants something."
Information.
Interrogation.
Or...
He was wary of the force standing behind them.
Whatever the reason.
The enemy had deliberately kept them alive.
Thinking of that the black-haired man’s eyes flashed.
He immediately tried another approach.
"Do you know who we are?" His voice carried both pain and arrogance.
Blood continued dripping onto the forest floor.
"Do you know..."
"...what will happen if you touch us?"
A naked threat.
He hoped mentioning their background would make the enemy hesitate.
Silence.
The armored figure didn’t answer.
Not even a single word.
His face remained completely hidden beneath the dark helmet.
Only those cold, blue eyes silently stared at them through the visor.
The eerie silence.
Made both men increasingly uneasy.
The brown-haired man swallowed hard.
"W-Why isn’t he saying anything?" His voice unconsciously trembled.
The black-haired man also felt something was terribly wrong.
Normally an enemy would either negotiate.
Or immediately attack.
This person did neither.
He simply watched them.
Like a predator observing two injured prey.
A cold chill crawled up the black-haired man’s spine.
"We have to escape."
Without saying a word.
He subtly glanced toward his companion.
Then using only his eyes.
He gave a signal.
Run.
The brown-haired man instantly understood.
Years of fighting together allowed them to communicate without words.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: The Void’s Deception
paragraphs: The black-haired man slowly tightened his grip on his sword.
His gaze never left the silent armored figure.
"I’ll hold him back."
"You report everything to Lord."
Even if he died here. The information about this mysterious assassin had to reach their master.
Otherwise the next people sent after Hero Luke. Would suffer the exact same fate.
The brown-haired man didn’t hesitate.
"RUN!!"
BOOM!!
Peak Silver Knight aura erupted from his body. A powerful shockwave swept across the surrounding forest.
Leaves scattered into the air. Branches bent violently beneath the pressure.
Without looking back he explosively kicked off the ground.
BOOOM!!
The earth beneath his feet instantly collapsed. Cracks spread outward like a spiderweb.
A cloud of dust exploded behind him as his figure shot toward the right side at astonishing speed—
Away from the black-haired man.
Away from the mysterious knight clad in dark-blue armor.
His only goal...
Escape.
Meanwhile—
The black-haired man also roared.
"HAH!"
His Peak Silver Knight aura burst forth as well.
Silver mana wrapped around his entire body.
His remaining hand tightened around his sword.
SWISH!!
He rushed straight toward Luke. His eyes burned with killing intent.
"As long as I keep him busy."
"He’ll escape!"
Yet.
The dark-blue armored knight never moved. He simply stood there.
Watching him approach.
The black-haired man’s eyebrows twitched.
"He’s not even taking me seriously?"
A vein bulged across his forehead.
"Bastard!"
The humiliation.
Combined with the pain from his severed arm. Instantly ignited the fury inside him.
"Fine!"
"Then don’t blame me!"
Aether wildly surged throughout his body.
He was about to activate his Ascension Series—
But then—
WHOOSSH!!
A sound tore through the air.
"Huh?!"
The black-haired man’s instincts exploded with warning.
His pupils shrank to pinpoints.
"An ambush?!"
He abruptly turned toward the right—
The exact direction where the brown-haired man had escaped moments earlier.
There...
A dark blur shot toward him at unbelievable speed.
So fast.
His eyes could barely follow it.
"Impossible!
Before he could even react—
BAAAAM!!!
The projectile slammed directly into his chest.
An explosive impact echoed throughout the forest.
"GUAAAH!!"
His body was blasted backward like a broken ragdoll.
CRAAASH!!
He smashed straight through a massive tree.
The thick trunk exploded apart.
Wood splinters erupted in every direction.
Before he could stop—
CRASH!!
A second tree shattered.
Then a third.
Only after plowing through multiple trees did his body finally come to a halt.
Dust filled the air. Broken branches rained down.
Silence.
"...Cough!"
"Pfft—!"
A mouthful of blood sprayed from his lips. The metallic taste instantly filled his mouth.
His vision blurred crimson.
Every bone in his body screamed in agony.
"W-What."
He painfully lifted his head. His trembling gaze slowly moved downward.
The place where the "projectile" had struck him.
But next moment, his pupils instantly dilated.
"W-What?" His voice trembled.
"How?" His words became stuck in his throat.
Lying beneath him was the unconscious brown-haired man.
Or rather what remained of him.
His other arm. had also been cleanly severed.
Blood continuously flowed from both shoulders, staining the forest floor crimson.
His breathing was shallow. His face deathly pale.
The black-haired man’s mind went blank.
"How did he catch him so quickly?"
His heart began pounding violently.
Then—
STEP.
A calm footstep echoed through the silent forest.
The black-haired man slowly raised his blood-covered face.
There.
The dark-blue armored knight calmly walked toward them.
Every step was steady.
Unhurried.
Like a judge approaching condemned criminals.
His heartbeat accelerated.
Then—
STEP.
Another footstep echoed.
"Huh?"
The black-haired man’s eyes instinctively shifted sideways.
Another.
Dark-blue armored knight had appeared. Standing silently beside the first.
His breathing suddenly became erratic.
"W-What?"
Before he could process it—
STEP.
STEP.
STEP.
One footstep after another echoed through the forest.
Like the footsteps of death itself.
Every few meters another identical armored figure silently emerged from the shadows.
Some appeared atop tree branches.
Others stepped out from behind massive trunks.
Each wore the same black-blue armor.
The same helmet. The same black halo floating above their heads. The same emotionless gaze.
Sadly, even now he didn’t identify the Luke. Because the Void themselves, were hiding his existence.
So even the Luke was front of him, he couldn’t pinpoint the person, was related to Luke.
Then within seconds.
Ten identical dark-blue knights completely surrounded them.
Cold sweat poured down the black-haired man’s face.
His lips trembled uncontrollably.
"Clones?"
Every single one radiated terrifying pressure.
The black-haired man swallowed with great difficulty.
Only one thought remained inside his mind.
"We’re completely screwed."
His face became ashen.
The last trace of confidence disappeared.
Far behind the circle of dopplegängers. The real Luke silently watched everything unfold.
Hidden beneath Null Veil of Nyx. The black-haired man couldn’t perceive him at all.
Luke deliberately kept his distance.
Not because he feared two Peak Silver Knights.
But because he had learned his lesson.
His mind unconsciously recalled the incident inside the Secret Realm.
Rowan.
That man had looked completely cornered as well.
Yet.
He still managed to pull out a terrifying trump card at the very last moment.
That experience had left a deep impression on Luke. "Never corner an enemy with your real body."
No matter how weak the opponent appeared. There was always the possibility they possessed a hidden ace.
Or some unknown means of dragging their enemy down with them.
Of course. This time.
Luke was overthinking things.
The magic scroll Rowan had used. Had originally been given to Roland by Oryn.
It wasn’t an ordinary item. It was a treasure that even most Golden Knights would hesitate to purchase.
Not because they couldn’t afford it. But because they preferred spending their wealth elsewhere.
A Golden Knight would almost always choose a powerful weapon.
Or an exceptional suit of armor.
Rather than an expensive mage-exclusive scroll they might never use.
As for Peak Silver Knights. Owning something of that level was exceedingly rare.
So.
These two men had absolutely no hidden trump cards.
Luke’s precautions ultimately proved unnecessary.
Still.
He didn’t regret them. Better to waste a little caution.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: The Longing For Selene
paragraphs: Soon.
The ten dopplegängers began the interrogation. Luke deliberately separated the two prisoners.
Neither knew what the other had already confessed.
Hours passed.
One by one.
Their psychological defenses crumbled.
Faced with relentless questioning. And a level of torture that made even seasoned assassins shiver.
Both men eventually broke.
In the end Luke obtained everything he wanted.
Their identities. The Viscount House they secretly served.
Their hidden scouting routes. Their communication methods.
The locations of several concealed observation posts.
Even more importantly.
They revealed the names of the Viscounts who had already begun treating Blackstone as an enemy.
However out of everything they confessed. One piece of information worried Luke the most.
It wasn’t the neighboring Viscounts. Nor the Hidden Hand.
It was a single name.
"The Vampires." Luke quietly repeated those words.
His expression gradually became solemn.
According to the two prisoners. News of his astonishing growth. And the disappearance of his "talentless" reputation.
Had already reached the Vampire’s.
More specifically...
It had reached the ears of Selene’s stepbrothers and stepsisters.
After learning that the man once dismissed as worthless had suddenly begun rising at a terrifying pace.
They had become uneasy.
Very uneasy.
As a result they had already begun making preparations.
"Selene."
The moment he whispered her name. His cold expression unconsciously softened.
Her beautiful smile appeared in his mind. Her playful teasing. Her enchanting laughter.
The way she loved clinging to him whenever no one was watching.
The sweet conversations they shared late into the night.
The little memories they had created together.
One scene after another. Quietly surfaced inside his heart.
Luke slowly lowered his gaze.
He didn’t know when it had happened.
But...
A dull ache suddenly spread through his chest.
It wasn’t pain.
It was...
Longing.
He missed her. Far more than he had realized.
At this very moment. He wanted nothing more than to fly straight to her.
To see her smile again. To hear her teasing voice.
Even if it was only for a few minutes. Luke unconsciously clenched his fist.
Then Luke slowly exhaled.
"I’ll go." His voice was quiet.
"But not now."
Not while he was still too weak. Not while Blackstone still needed him.
One day, he would go to her. Not merely to visit Selene. But to truly free her.
So that no one from the Vampire Royal Family could ever threaten or control her again.
Only when he possessed enough strength. Would he able to bring her home openly.
Luke slowly pushed those thoughts aside.
His expression gradually returned to normal.
Then he focused once more on the information the two spies had revealed.
"Whether the Vampire reason for targetting me is true or not."
He narrowed his eyes. "It doesn’t matter."
Perhaps Selene’s stepbrothers and stepsisters truly feared his rapid growth.
Perhaps they had entirely different motives.
Luke couldn’t determine that with certainty.
But one thing was beyond doubt.
"The Vampires are coming after me."
He quietly muttered. That fact alone was enough to make him raise his guard.
Fortunately.
The interrogation had also yielded another extremely important piece of information.
It concerned the true powerhouses of this world.
According to the spies. Those who had reached the Platinum Knight Realm.
And every realm above it.
Could rarely move about freely. Not because they lacked freedom.
But because. Their existence was simply overwhelming.
The energy constantly radiating from their bodies was terrifying.
Even without intentionally releasing their aura.
Higher-realm experts could sense one another from astonishing distances.
Unless.
They cultivated an exceptional concealment technique.
Or possessed a rare treasure capable of completely suppressing their presence.
Otherwise their mere existence was like a blazing sun in the darkness.
Impossible to hide.
Luke listened carefully. The spies had also mentioned another method.
The Mage Association had developed specialized detection instruments.
Artifacts capable of sensing the energy signatures of high-level cultivators.
Their purpose was simple. Monitoring walking catastrophes.
Because a Platinum Knight and above wasn’t merely a powerful individual.
They were a living natural disaster.
If such a being fought without restraint. Then entire cities could be reduced to ruins.
Countless lives could disappear in moments.
Even more frightening. They didn’t necessarily need to attack.
According to the spies.
If a Platinum Knight completely released their aura.
Ordinary mortals who had never begun cultivation.
Could die from the pressure alone.
That was precisely why. These detection devices had been installed throughout the continent.
Learning this.
Luke finally felt a little relieved.
He silently let out a breath he hadn’t realized he was holding.
"Good."
At least.
He currently had no means of dealing with beings at the Platinum Knight Realm.
If one truly descended upon Blackstone.
There would be little he could do.
Fortunately.
The world itself seemed to possess restraints against such monsters.
However.
That relief only lasted for a moment.
Luke’s expression soon became serious again.
"Though."
"They can still send Peak Golden Knights." His brows slowly furrowed.
That possibility was far more realistic.
According to the information he had gathered.
Peak Golden Knights stood at the very limit of the Golden Realm.
They had already begun touching. The properties of the Platinum Realm.
Although they hadn’t truly stepped across that threshold.
Their strength was still terrifying beyond imagination.
Even Aurielle had known very little about that level.
Whenever the conversation reached the Platinum Realm and beyond.
The available knowledge abruptly stopped.
As if someone had deliberately restricted its spread.
Even she had been confused by it.
Luke also had found that strange at the time.
After thinking for a while.
Luke slowly looked toward the endless sky.
A helpless smile appeared beneath his helmet.
"Still."
"I sincerely hope."
"No Peak Golden Knight comes at all."
Luke silently offered a prayer.
"Goddess of Luck."
"Please let me stay lucky a little longer."
The forest remained silent.
No miracle occurred.
No divine voice answered him.
Only a gentle breeze drifted past.
Carrying away his quiet prayer into the endless sky.
That’s why, I have released this 19 Chapter as bonus, with cheap price. For this month. July, 2026.
-EternalVoidRuler.

The properties of the Platinum Realm.
Although they hadn’t truly stepped across that threshold.
Their strength was still terrifying beyond imagination.
Even Aurielle had known very little about that level.
Whenever the conversation reached the Platinum Realm and beyond.
The available knowledge abruptly stopped.
As if someone had deliberately restricted its spread.
Even she had been confused by it.
Luke also had found that strange at the time.
After thinking for a while.
Luke slowly looked toward the endless sky.
A helpless smile appeared beneath his helmet.
"Still."
"I sincerely hope."
"No Peak Golden Knight comes at all."
Luke silently offered a prayer.
"Goddess of Luck."
"Please let me stay lucky a little longer."
The forest remained silent.
No miracle occurred.
No divine voice answered him.
Only a gentle breeze drifted past.
Carrying away his quiet prayer into the endless sky.
That’s why, I have released this 19 Chapter as bonus, with cheap price.
For this month.
July, 2026.
-EternalVoidRuler.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: The Gambling on Luke
paragraphs: After finishing off all those who were actively spying on Blackstone, Luke and his Doppelganger covered every place of the whole 1000km road with Watchtowers, which was 100 towers.
Because each had a 5km radius, meaning a 10km diameter. So every watchtower was placed at a 10km distance.
Then he also placed one at the start and one at the end, so the total watchtowers for the roads were 102.
On which, soon guards would mount them.
After that he dismissed his nine doppelgangers and let the one remain in normal human form, who would patrol the whole area around Blackstone territory.
Because for a single human-form doppelganger, he could sustain them almost infinitely.
As his stamina regeneration was way faster than the one doppelganger consumed.

Then he returned back to the territory and placed 10 additional watchtowers around the whole 1km long, 800m wide territory. To show dominance and prevent some foolish people from provoking him or doing theft in his territory, under the astonished gaze of citizens.

While Luke was doing this, four people, three men and one woman, were watching his actions from the building of the Alchemist Association. Each gaze held different meaning, which they didn’t say out loud.
These four were the new managers the union assigned to Blackstone territory. And each represented one faction.
ALCHEMIST ASSOCIATION BRANCH - The Wolf’s Bane
BLACKSMITH ASSOCIATION BRANCH - The Cinder Smithy
MERCHANT GUILD BRANCH - The Silver Exchange
ADVENTURER GUILD BRANCH - Sapphire Trail
There was not any Mage Association or other association present in Blackstone. At least for now.
"How arrogant!" Hermes Bane shouted, while seeing Luke placing those buildings.
Hermes Bane was an elderly old man, with a frail body and long white hair and beard.
Even though, from his clothes he was exuding a scholarly aura, as he was the newly assigned manager of The Wolf’s Bane, the Alchemist Association.
His whole personality still showed his arrogant personality, because of his career as an Alchemist, in which they found themselves superior. Plus he was also a mid-golden knight.
So seeing Luke, the Baron of this territory, had not come to meet him to pay his respects, he became angry.
Hearing his angry voice, the others didn’t react, which worsened his mood more.
Because he didn’t want to come to this backward place at all. Even the Alchemist Association was a giant, which was a union of millions of Alchemist organizations.
But still each organization operated alone. Like, he was from The Wolf’s Bane, who started their journey by researching the wolf beast.
Which later made them famous, because they developed potions related to wolves, which could even grant wolf-like powers, such as enhanced senses, smell, hearing, and claws.
They even generated some potions, which on higher rank, could allow the person to transform into a wolf, which soared the popularity of their organization to another level.
Of course, they sold other potions as well.
So the headquaters opened this branch here because of the Stormhowl Mountains, which had all types of beasts, and among them, many rare species of wolves could also be found.
"Is it because he is a hero that he thinks he is someone great?" He again shouted, on which the others still didn’t show any reaction.
Because the association they were part of, in front of them, even emperors had to lower their demands sometimes. So what was a hero in front of them?
Because all of them had rich history and many powerhouses were even sitting there.
"This hero is not suitable for our support at all." Hermes shouted again, but this time in total refusal.
Because of this, he was sent here to identify the hero’s talent and recruit Luke.
In the start, they would support him, and when he became strong, or along the journey, he would advertise their name while also helping them in need.
This method was perfect and had already worked with previous heroes. But sadly, The Wolf’s Bane didn’t have any hero or high-status people under them or connected with them.
Which was why they wanted to gamble on Luke.
But now, seeing Hermes’s behavior, it seemed difficult.
"Calm down Hermes." Chalybs Cinder, an 8-foot muscular man, said in a calm voice to him.
He was also the manager of THE CINDER SMITHY — Blacksmith Association Branch.
His family was famous for making amazing quality weapons and armor using their ancestral Cinder technique.
He as well here for the same reason as Hermes, and along with that an mid-golden knight.
Hearing Chalybs’s voice, Hermes calmed down a little bit, and with a hmph!, he took a seat toward the table before sitting down.
Jasper Merrick from his seat watched all the drama. He was the manager of THE SILVER EXCHANGE — Merchant Guild Branch.
They followed one motto.
*"Gold is for kings. Silver is for the people. And the people are where true wealth is built."*
And that’s why they placed this name for their merchant organization.
Jasper was an adult man. Even though he was in his 60s, his hair was still black, trimmed, and the same for his beard.
Even his whole body was fit.
He was around 6 feet, and was am mid-golden knight who had the same purpose as those two.
But there was a problem.
He lost in thought after hearing the news from the merchants.
’Two types of potions.’ These potions were the problem for Hermes, the Alchemist organization, which was also one of the reasons he was angry at Luke.
And he was also worried, because he had heard that Baron Luke was opening a store, which might spread to other places.
Even though he didn’t think Baron Luke could create a large merchant organization like they did.
But still, this could conflict with their business.
’Whatever, having a hero’s support is more important.’ He thought, while shaking his head to remove earlier thoughts.
Then he looked toward the last person, who was a female demi, a tiger woman. Raya Tempestas.
The manager of SAPPHIRE TRAIL — Adventurer Guild Branch.

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Ignorance Is Bliss
paragraphs: The appearance of a demi was not considered surprising now, after the union spread among all continents.
In which they could bring their business to other races continents and, after getting permission from the lord of the territory, they could build their buildings.
Still, when they built, they took a contract on the land for decades, because if the lord changed, then they could order them to be removed from the territory.
But regardless of this, many lords allowed them in their territory.
First, they brought new resources, new opportunities.
Second, they also brought new talent and services, which could help the territory.
Third, even though the managers didn’t interfere with the lord’s rule and often limited themselves to their building.
Still, many hostile organizations were wary of attacking the territory, because if, by mistake, they attacked them or their territory,
Then they would have to bear their wrath, which none of them wanted.

Earlier, when Luke released lightning in the Viscount’s territory, he did it toward the gate entrance, which didn’t have any of these buildings, or else he would have had to face even more problems, which were outside his limits.
’So the news was true,’ he thought, while recalling the info.
That the Tigris race belonged to royalty.
But she badly beat the suitor who wanted to marry her.
And that’s why she was assigned here as a new manager for punishment.
Though, he didn’t know if the Tempestas family would also want to rope in the hero.
As the Beast Empire had their own hero.
"What?" Raya noticed Jasper’s gaze and said irritably.
Hearing her words, Jasper replied, "Nothing," then looked toward the other people.
"Hmph" Raya snorted in annoyance, because she didn’t like to be in a closed room.
She liked to fight the strong, and that’s why she asked for a fight with the person who said he wanted to marry her.
’Duckless bastard.’ She cursed him, because with one punch, he cried out and started cursing her, asking how a lady could be this fierce.
So, in anger, she beat that bastard even more, which resulted in her being sent here.
"At least, I don’t have to see those duckless faces." She said, without care, on which both Hermes and Jasper flinched.
Because, even though they were in the same realm, they didn’t have the confidence to beat her.
After all, she was royalty who had excellent ascension series and artifacts.
Only Chalybs smiled at her and didn’t mind her words, as this was his personality.
Raya didn’t say anything further; she just wanted to leave this place fast.
But this was their first meeting and she had to be somewhat formal.
So she leaned her back against the chair, while her long yellow hair with brown streaks swayed gracefully behind the chair, and her tails also swayed slightly.
Suprisingly no one in the territory knew that four mid-golden knight ranks were having a meeting in Alchemist bulding.
If Luke knew that, he would freak out and his sleep would completely disappear for day.s
So ignorance was truly bliss.
Luke completely finished his work and was about to head to the Time Chamber, when a mummy suddenly appeared in front of him.
"Ye-OSric." He controlled his startled expression, as he still didn’t get used to Osric’s bandaged appearance.
He didn’t understand that why not Osric, took a bath in the healing spring to fix those cuts.
Sadly Osric had tried everything, but the purple sword of Aurielle had done harm, which the healing spring couldn’t properly fix.
So he was taking a higher-grade potion to fix this.
"My Lord, one adventurer team wants to meet with you and their leader is an early golden knight." Osric didn’t mind Luke’s startled expression, as he relayed the information respectfully.
’Huh? Adventurer team with an early golden.’ Luke rubbed his chin thoughtfully and nodded.
Next moment, the space behind him rippled and one more Luke came out.
"Let’s go." The second doppelganger urged Osric to lead, whose mouth was open even from under the bandages.
Even though it was not Osric’s first time seeing Luke’s doppelganger, he still got shocked by this.
"Y-Yes!" He stuttered, as he led the second Luke toward the guest hall, which was smaller than the earlier Gathering Hall.
"Well, that’s handy." Luke muttered seeing both of them going. As now he was feeling that having many bodies can help greatly in managing territory.
"So what should I do?" He looked and recalled if there was anything he needed, while he also moved toward the Time Chamber.
In the Guest Hall...
As Osric and Luke entered the guest hall, Luke observed the seated persons which were two men. One had broader shoulders, dark brown hair, and deep brown eyes. His expression looked nervous.
While the other man, who had a lean build, also had dark brown hair, was saying something to the other man.
They seemed to be around their 30s and had normal outfits, rather than any attire of adventurers, which was maybe because they were not going on any mission now.
As both entered, their gazes shifted towards them. Both of them stood up before bowing respectfully to Luke.
"Greetings Baron Luke."
Luke nodded at their greeting, before taking a seat opposite to them on the sofa, while Osric, still in a bandaged state, stood behind him.
Then Luke asked one question which he had all the way, after hearing his realm.
"You are an Early Golden Knight. So you can even join some Count’s territory at a high post."
"Then why joining me?"
Luke leaned back, while asking with a relaxed expression.
Even though, he didn’t find them suspicious, he didn’t know why, but maybe something related to his realm or titan.
Which also increased his stamina compared to a same-realm knight.
The result was that even Aurielle, a late Bronze Knight, could not continue long enough with him in bed.
Earlier, he asked the system about this, who only replied at that time.
[You will find out at the Silver Knight realm.]
Yeah, forgot about that. He returned his focus to the broader-built person, waiting for his answer.
Patrick became nervous hearing this. Even though he was an Early Golden Knight, he was a quiet type person and he often had problems with communication.
His brother, Peter, saw this and shook his head before greeting Luke and saying.
"Sir Luke. I am sorry for my big brother’s quiet behavior."
"As he is not good at talking."
Luke nodded at him to continue. Then he told their names. After that, he told their real objective for joining.
"Sir Luke. Actually, we belong to the Bassus noble family, which was destroyed 30 years ago."
"Still, our mother survived and both of us survived, as our father sacrificed himself to save us, to give us enough time to run."
His eyes became a little red and moist thinking this, because at that time they were only small children.
The same was true for Patrick as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: The Chain Quest Triggered
paragraphs: So he recounted how their family survived by hiding in small villages or towns.
But the enemy had found them again and now wanted to kill their old mother and them.
So they escaped here in the hope of taking refuge and starting a new family here.
He also mentioned why they didn’t took refuge in other noble houses, like a Count.
Because each rejected them as they didn’t want the trouble of the enemy coming to their door.
"Then why not go towards Count Magnus Duvell? the lord of Stormveil County." Luke leaned slightly as he asked this.
Though little annoyed, if even Count who had many golden knight, didn’t want your trouble, then how could he who was Baron, could even face that.
At this, the faces of Peter and Patrick changed to ugly, and he said with a helpless voice.
"Sir Luke. I do want to go, but our enemy is also a follower of the Storm God."
"So, Count Magnus would not let us in either."
Hearing this, Luke raised his eyebrow and felt there was something more.
Even though Peter was good at hiding his expression, he could observe Patrick, whose face was telling that going to Count territory would be dangerous for them.
"Hm..." Luke picked up the glass of wine and drank it leisurely, as thinking what to say.
While the expressions of Patrick and Peter became tense, as they felt that maybe Baron Luke would also ignore them.

Earlier, they had an argument about coming here. Because Patrick, the big brother, felt that Hero Luke had the most potential to reach higher realm, and if that was possible, then they could even get revenge on the enemy.
On which Peter didn’t agree, because he heard from their mother that a real hero was only proven after the awakening ceremony, not before.

So he could not bet on Hero Luke. But still they came here, as he was the only one who had protection from the Holy Church, and he was also the husband of five princesses, so that person wouldn’t dare to threaten Luke.
With that Patrick exchanged quick glances with Peter, ’asking should they use that info?’
At this, Peter shook his head, because they only had this valuable thing, which their father gave them.
Luke, out of the corner of his eye, saw the interaction between them, which brought a satisfied smile to his face.
’Come on... bring your cards out fast.’
And he continued sipping normally, like he was waiting for them to say something worthwhile and give him the reason to let them stay.
Then he heard what he was waiting for.
"Sir Luke." Patrick controlled his nervous expression and looked straight at Luke’s eyes.
At this, Luke also brought down the wine glass and met his eyes.
"Sir, we have one thing, which will definitely be useful to you."
"But, Sir, you have to promise us that you will help us getting revenge by killing that enemy."
’Oh...’ Luke brought the wine glass again to his lips when he heard this and sipped the drink slowly.
Then he signaled them to continue, as their enemy would most likely be a mid-golden knight. So he would deal with them easily.
"Sir, the enemy who wants to kill us is a Diamond stage powerhouse."
"Pfft!"
"Cough! Cough!"
Hearing this, the wine Luke just drank sprayed outside, as he spat it out and gave both of them a speechless look, who were now covered with wine that had escaped from his mouth.
While Osric’s eyes also became wide. ’Diamond Knight! A powerhouse of Marquis noble level.’
’How the heck did they provoke someone of that caliber!’
While the same question was coming to Luke’s mind, ’What the hell did they do!’
’Even sleeping with their daughter, wouldn’t bring this chase... or maybe it will.’
Seeing Luke’s look, both of them coughed and told him that the person who was hunting them was from the Beast Empire.
And he was also behind the info their father got from the Stormhowl Mountains.
Where, one demi-human who was in our father team, betrayed them and told the news to the Marquis.
After that, the Marquis sent assassins of high rank to keep killing their family members, until he used his human friend noble help to destroy their noble house.
Which they did it succesfully, by making false allegations.
"Nah, no!"
"A Marquis, a Diamond Knight."
"You think too highly of me."
Luke gave them another speechless look and prepared to get up to end this meeting.
Seeing this, Patrick panicked and immediately brought out the treasure, which seemed to be a worn-out ancient map.
And presented it to Luke, before shouting in a hurry.
"Please, sir, only you can become strong enough to bring us revenge, and this treasure will definitely help you in that."
He shouted, but Luke shook his head, ’Who is willing to hold that hot potato?’
’Definitely only insan-’
DING!
’Insan-’
DING!!
Luke’s eyes twitched, ’Can you let me finish my dialogue?’
’And system, these are men, not women. So don’t start your sage mode.’
Luke thought annoyingly and was about to finally finish his dialogue when something else came, upon which he really thought that becoming an insane person doesn’t feel bad at all.
[CHAIN QUEST TRIGGERED]
[TEMPLE OF ???]
Difficulty: Peak Bronze Knight.
[QUEST OBJECTIVE]
"Retrieve the ??? fragment."
[QUEST DESCRIPTION]
"They failed once... and so the cycle began anew."
"The Map did not lead you here."
"It found you."
"For no map was ever drawn... it was planted."
"A conspiracy older than kingdoms."
"They seek to awaken the One whose mere existence unraveled reality."
"The One whose true name was struck from history... because even those who ruled eternity feared to speak it."
"They believed the erasure was enough."
"Was it?"
"The Anomaly has already found you."
"And now... the Forgotten watch in silence."
"Waiting."
"For the Erased One to awaken once more."
"Tell us..."
"Can that which has been erased... truly cease to exist?"
