sentences.text: So he recounted how their family survived by hiding in small villages or towns.
But the enemy had found them again and now wanted to kill their old mother and them.
So they escaped here in the hope of taking refuge and starting a new family here.
He also mentioned why they didn’t took refuge in other noble houses, like a Count.
Because each rejected them as they didn’t want the trouble of the enemy coming to their door.
"Then why not go towards Count Magnus Duvell? the lord of Stormveil County." Luke leaned slightly as he asked this.
Though little annoyed, if even Count who had many golden knight, didn’t want your trouble, then how could he who was Baron, could even face that.
At this, the faces of Peter and Patrick changed to ugly, and he said with a helpless voice.
"Sir Luke.
I do want to go, but our enemy is also a follower of the Storm God."
"So, Count Magnus would not let us in either."
Hearing this, Luke raised his eyebrow and felt there was something more.
Even though Peter was good at hiding his expression, he could observe Patrick, whose face was telling that going to Count territory would be dangerous for them.
"Hm..." Luke picked up the glass of wine and drank it leisurely, as thinking what to say.
While the expressions of Patrick and Peter became tense, as they felt that maybe Baron Luke would also ignore them.
Earlier, they had an argument about coming here.
Because Patrick, the big brother, felt that Hero Luke had the most potential to reach higher realm, and if that was possible, then they could even get revenge on the enemy.
On which Peter didn’t agree, because he heard from their mother that a real hero was only proven after the awakening ceremony, not before.
So he could not bet on Hero Luke.
But still they came here, as he was the only one who had protection from the Holy Church, and he was also the husband of five princesses, so that person wouldn’t dare to threaten Luke.
With that Patrick exchanged quick glances with Peter, ’asking should they use that info?’
At this, Peter shook his head, because they only had this valuable thing, which their father gave them.
Luke, out of the corner of his eye, saw the interaction between them, which brought a satisfied smile to his face.
’Come on... bring your cards out fast.’
And he continued sipping normally, like he was waiting for them to say something worthwhile and give him the reason to let them stay.
Then he heard what he was waiting for.
"Sir Luke." Patrick controlled his nervous expression and looked straight at Luke’s eyes.
At this, Luke also brought down the wine glass and met his eyes.
"Sir, we have one thing, which will definitely be useful to you."
"But, Sir, you have to promise us that you will help us getting revenge by killing that enemy."
’Oh...’ Luke brought the wine glass again to his lips when he heard this and sipped the drink slowly.
Then he signaled them to continue, as their enemy would most likely be a mid-golden knight.
So he would deal with them easily.
"Sir, the enemy who wants to kill us is a Diamond stage powerhouse."
"Pfft!"
"Cough!
Cough!"
Hearing this, the wine Luke just drank sprayed outside, as he spat it out and gave both of them a speechless look, who were now covered with wine that had escaped from his mouth.
While Osric’s eyes also became wide. ’Diamond Knight!
A powerhouse of Marquis noble level.’
’How the heck did they provoke someone of that caliber!’
While the same question was coming to Luke’s mind, ’What the hell did they do!’
’Even sleeping with their daughter, wouldn’t bring this chase... or maybe it will.’
Seeing Luke’s look, both of them coughed and told him that the person who was hunting them was from the Beast Empire.
And he was also behind the info their father got from the Stormhowl Mountains.
Where, one demi-human who was in our father team, betrayed them and told the news to the Marquis.
After that, the Marquis sent assassins of high rank to keep killing their family members, until he used his human friend noble help to destroy their noble house.
Which they did it succesfully, by making false allegations.
"Nah, no!"
"A Marquis, a Diamond Knight."
"You think too highly of me."
Luke gave them another speechless look and prepared to get up to end this meeting.
Seeing this, Patrick panicked and immediately brought out the treasure, which seemed to be a worn-out ancient map.
And presented it to Luke, before shouting in a hurry.
"Please, sir, only you can become strong enough to bring us revenge, and this treasure will definitely help you in that."
He shouted, but Luke shook his head, ’Who is willing to hold that hot potato?’
’Definitely only insan-’
DING!
’Insan-’
DING!!
Luke’s eyes twitched, ’Can you let me finish my dialogue?’
’And system, these are men, not women.
So don’t start your sage mode.’
Luke thought annoyingly and was about to finally finish his dialogue when something else came, upon which he really thought that becoming an insane person doesn’t feel bad at all.
[CHAIN QUEST TRIGGERED]
[TEMPLE OF ???]
Difficulty: Peak Bronze Knight.
[QUEST OBJECTIVE]
"Retrieve the ??? fragment."
[QUEST DESCRIPTION]
"They failed once... and so the cycle began anew."
"The Map did not lead you here."
"It found you."
"For no map was ever drawn... it was planted."
"A conspiracy older than kingdoms."
"They seek to awaken the One whose mere existence unraveled reality."
"The One whose true name was struck from history... because even those who ruled eternity feared to speak it."
"They believed the erasure was enough."
"Was it?"
"The Anomaly has already found you."
"And now... the Forgotten watch in silence."
"Waiting."
"For the Erased One to awaken once more."
"Tell us..."
"Can that which has been erased... truly cease to exist?"
"The answer lay in the temple."
[REWARD]
SSS rank - Titan Knight skill evolved.

chapters.title: Chapter 192: The Lady Aurielle’s Trauma
paragraphs: ’Chain quest?’ Luke became surprised, so he asked the system about this.
The system explained that chain quests were type of long quest, which would follow a single type revolving around same entity or object.
And in the future it would come again if certain trigger conditions were met.
’So the rewards will be the same?’ After hearing the system’s answer, Luke asked this as well.
Because he heard from Aurielle that all heroes had an SSS rank origin skill. Which was also one of the reasons for their insane growth in the start. And also the reason for their insane combat power.
"Though mine is fake." Luke muttered under his breath, with a cheated expression, on which an annoyed emoji followed.
[Luke, I told you already. It’s not my fault. You were targeted and that’s why you didn’t have those benefits.]
He knew this, still it annoyed him. Because earlier he had asked the system *why his skill couldn’t fix it.*
But on that, the system didn’t reply or didn’t want to talk.
Then system return back to topic and gave the previous question answer.
Meanwhile...
The Bassus brothers just stared at the stunned hero, who was muttering something under his breath, likely talking with a ghost.
’Ghost!’ At that thought, both of their faces became pale and they looked around warily, while Osric just shook his head.
Because everyone close to Luke alrady knew, that many times he often acted like this, which almost everyone had got accustomed to.
Luke noticed all three expressions, but didn’t care.
[Yes, your skill would be upgraded each time.]
’That’s insane!’ Upon this his face lit up with big smile.
After that, he read the description again to make sure. He didn’t missed anything.
Though, all of the descritpion was full of unknowns, and he could even find that he was involved in some kind of conspiracy.
Which maked him warry, despite this he knew the system would not answer him, even if he asked, so he just ignored that part and hoped maybe he would find some answer inside this temple.
But still, when he looked at the difficulty part, he became flabbergasted. ’Bronze knight difficulty?’
’That’s it?’
’I thought it would be something dangerous-’
[Luke, it is.]
Luke’s thought stopped by the system’s sudden intervention, but after hearing his words,
He became curious. ’Why would you say that?’
’You know, I am already fighting golden knights. So doesn’t Bronze Knight combat power seem easy to me?’
The system paused for a moment before answering his query, which he had already said once before.
[You know about higher species, which I had said before.]
Luke nodded, because he remembered clearly why his Titan transformation had more power at the same stage compared to oth--
’Wait.’
His expression changed to shocked, when this thought came. Because the system did give an example.
That a dragon at the same realm could easily take down a higher realm of lower species, like humans, goblins, etc...
Though the goblins part he added himself. But still, this meant that what he was going to face in that dungeon also belonged to an upper species.
How much upper, he couldn’t guess, so he asked the expert.
[Titans.]
"O_O"
Luke’s mouth fully opened with shock. ’Titans!!!’
’A f*cking real titan.’
Of course he was fake, because he didn’t have even a single percentage of a real titan in his bloodline.
Even though he could literally transform into Nyx, Myrkhal and Caelith, even that, the system said, they were pure titans, not your transformation.
So facing a real titan gave him... some goosebumps.
*Why some?*
Because he was excited...
Excited to find if a real titan was stronger or his fake transformation.
As Luke was thinking this, a large grin slowly appeared on his face, which freaked out the three of them.
’Has the Master finally lost it?’ Osric sighed, while feeling pity for his lord.
’I knew this day would come. After all, Lady Aurielle gave him so much trauma.’
If Luke knew Osric thoughts, then he would definetly add more works to him.
Meanwhile, the other two were also thinking, not the same things, which was Osric thinking. Instead,
’Is Sir Luke being so happy thinking about the treasure he would get from this map?’
At this, question marks appeared on both heads, because the treasure hadn’t even been found yet and Luke was being happy even before it.
"Ahem!" Luke noticed their weird expressions and coughed to remove their gaze.
Before looking toward the system screen, which was showing the direction and the location of the temple on Stormhowl Mountains.
’So no need for this ancient paper.’ Luke noticed, because he had just touched the paper and the system had already uploaded the map location in it.
After this, he made a generous face. Who didn’t like to take benefits, instead helped everyone.
"I don’t need your treasure, you can have it."
Hearing Luke’s words, both Bassus brothers eyes widened which make them confused. ’No need?’
Seeing their confused faces, he said, "Since you are willing to become my subordinates."
"Then how could I? as your lord, take advantage of my subordinate."
Luke said with a smile, before looking straight at their eyes with an expression that clearly said, *I am a generous lord.*
Upon this, Patrick’s eyes became moist, while Peter became somewhat became more confused.
Though Patrick didn’t notice this and shouted.
"Lord, thank you."
"Thank you so much for your grace."
"I, Patrick, will serve you with all my might and will not back away, even if the enemy is a Platinum Knight."
’Yeah, because you would die the moment a being of this level comes in front of you.’ Luke still maintained a smile and didn’t dare to say his thoughts out loud.
After that he ordered Osric to call Aurora and let them take an oath, before also arranging accommodation for them.
Then he left with a cheerful smile and didn’t even notice that Osric was giving him a respectful gaze from behind.
’Lord is so generous that he was even willing to face a Diamond Knight for his subordinate.’
If Luke found out his thoughts, he would give him an idiot look, because who in their right mind would face a Diamond Knight with their Golden Knight combat power.
Meanwhile.
The original Luke, who was practicing his skills inside the time chamber, knew all of this, because using his half focus, he was controlling this clone all the time.
This technique Nyx had taught him earlier during his long practice. Of course, currently, he couldn’t control all of his clones at the same time.
And he had to give them orders, which they followed subconsciously, while using previous memory patterns of Luke.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Aurielle’s Tears
paragraphs: While walking through the hallways, Luke thought about when he should depart for the temple.
Because according to the system map, it seemed to be near Ashveil route surprisingly.
"MY LORD!"
Suddenly a loud voice came from the front, followed by Noah, the young butler whom Luke had met fizrst after awakening in Blackstone.
He saw his running figure and his breathing was even rough, while his face looked nervous.
So Luke stopped, and during the wait for him to come, he recalled that earlier he didn’t see him much inside the mansion.
Later he found out, that he had become the main head of checking the progress of the walls that were being built around the Blackstone.
"My lord." Noah called him again, on which Luke told him to calm down first.
So Noah took deep breaths to calm down, before telling the news.
"Lord, Miss Margaret and Sir Kai, along with other knights, have returned to the territory."
Luke raised his eyebrow upon this. ’That’s a good news, so why was his face still filled with worry.’
Noah, after saying that, added, "Lady Evelyne has also returned with them."
"Huh?" Luke became surprised that the aunt of Aurielle, who had managed Blackstone Territory earlier, had returned.
And she even got the guts to return with the Blackstone knights.
’Doesn’t she know that Blackstone has a new ruler?’
’And she had embezzled money from this territory before, So she should be afraid.’ While Luke was thinking about her guts, Noah said one last thing, which also made his face worry.
"And Lady Aurielle is already facing her."
"What!" On this, Luke immediately stopped his thinking and instantly headed toward the location. Because he didn’t know if Aurielle, in anger, would use her power openly.
Since this territory was like home to her, and the news about her aunt embezzling money, would had hurt her the most.
At the entrance of the territory, near the main gate, a huge crowd had gathered.
Initially it was for the welcome of returning knights. But later the crowd got bigger due to the appearance of Aurielle and Evelyne.
There both of them were looking at each other, where one eye held anger, while the other held calmness.
Margaret looked worriedly from the side, but didn’t try to stop Aurielle, as she also knew how much Aurielle loved her territory, which was her home.
Then she looked toward the other woman, who had long black hair, same as Aurielle, but her eyes were a little black, mixed with purple.
Even though Evelyne was in her 40s, no one present could deny the beauty she held, which was almost comparable to her sister, the mother of Aurielle.
"Miss Margaret, is it really okay?" Kai from the side asked in a low voice.
He was happy when he heard the news of the territory’s victory against Ashenford, and all of them felt proud of their master.
So when everyone was returning back, they found Lady Evelyne on the road who was also returning back to the territory.
Even though he had heard the news of her corruption, still he chose to let her be in his group.
With the thought that their master and his wife, would deal with her.
At that time, Margaret also didn’t say anything. But now it seemed the situation had become worse.
Margaret heard Kai’s answer and just shook her head, while hoping that Lady Aurielle would not make a scene, atleast in front of the crowd.
"Why!" But she did.
Aurielle shouted at her, as her eyes became moist.
Because before getting imprisoned, her mother told her to treat Evelyne the same as her.
Her second mother, which Aurielle did.
Even though Evelyne didn’t give her much attention all those years, she always thought of her as someone close.
Close enough, that she would take care of the territory while her sister was imprisoned.
So Aurielle asked this simple question.
Evelyne sighed seeing her niece’s behavior. And instead of replying, she looked around toward the gathered crowd.
She could even identify some faces among the merchants and adventurers that she had seen before leaving the territory.
While not any familiar knight faces. Even though she had heard about the upheaval in Blackstone.
And got surprised after finding that her niece had married a hero. Afterward, she even made him the lord.
Though, later she found that the hero was talentless and was not married to one but five princesses.
At that time, she became shocked with this news. So she hurried back from the kingdom capital to meet her.
Still she was also worried that Aurielle would find out about her embezzling money.
Even though she came back with full confidence that Aurielle would not make things difficult for her.
But now the situation seemed different.
"Aurielle, we should talk inside." She calmly said to her, but Aurielle didn’t reply to her, instead asked again.
"WHY!"
This time, her voice was even louder than before, which made the surrounding people start gossiping.
"Isn’t she Lady Evelyne? the sister of Lady Seraphina."
"Why then, her own niece, Lady Aurielle, was shouting at her?"
New people became confused, while the existing citizens and even many merchants and adventurers knew why she was questioning her.
But none said anything loud, only gossiping among themselves.
For a moment, only the sound of gossip echoed throughout the vicinity, while Aurielle and Evelyne just stared at each other.
Luke’s clone just came out this time and from afar saw this situation clearly.
"Thank goddess, she didn’t go berserk." He thanked his blessed stars, before moving toward them.
Everyone turned at the newcomer, when they found who it was, everyone’s expression instantly changed.
The previous playful manner and gossip stopped, while every eyes looked at Luke.
The Baron Luke with respect, fear, awe and reverence.
"Its Lord!"
Then murmurs spread again among the crowd, but this time they started discussing Luke’s deeds.
Though each of their voices was low, because everyone could see the situation.
Evelyne also became surprised by the gathered people’s reaction and turned to look at newcomer with a curious gaze.
"It’s nice seeing you, Hero Luke, husband of my niece." With a smiling face she said those words out.
Still, she didn’t mention anything about Baron.
But Luke didn’t care, he just gave her a nod, then turned his gaze toward the knights who had just returned.
They understood his gaze and the next moment,
"Everyone move back!"
"Don’t crowd the area!"
"Don’t block the road!"
Soon, all of them began clearing the roads, while Luke moved toward Aurielle, who was also looking at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 194: The False Accusation At Seraphina
paragraphs: However, she failed to notice that the person standing in front of her was a clone of him.
Even when her heart was bound with Luke from the golden chains, which had the goddess herself cast.
Then how did she not notice?
Well the answer was simple. Nyx had already mentioned to Luke that he had perfected this ability to the extreme.
And he was not summoning an ordinary clone, instead he was bringing his other self, which existed somewhere in the Void that was connected to many realities.
Because of that, all clones of Luke also had their hearts bound by golden chains, which even Luke had not noticed.
As the Void was hiding it.
Because of that, unless the goddess came herself, she would not be able to find the real golden chains from the heavans, as all of them were real, but from different realities.
Even that could be fixed if Luke became strong or increased his mastery over the Shadow of Nyx.
"Aurielle, let’s go." Luke gently said to her, not using honey or darling in front of the public.
Aurielle came out of her anger and nodded, before giving one last glare to the smiling Evelyne.
After that, she headed toward the mansion.
Luke watched her go, then turned toward Evelyne and observed her more clearly.
She had some features which matched Aurielle, like her hair.
"You as well." With that he also followed suit, while Evelyne sighed once more, before following them.
In the mansion, Evelyne looked at the night clouds through the window.
Her mood was down.
After the initial talk, no one had come to disturb her. And she was now staying inside her old room, which was maintained clean.
She recalled the times where both of them, her sisters and she were good to each other and were happy.
Until that night, the Human Emperor came, who was returning from Stormhowl Mountains, and took a liking to Seraphina.
At that time she was also with her sister, though the Human Emperor didn’t choose her.
The reason she came to know later: Seraphina’s purple eyes.
Yeah, because of a damn purple eye.
Soon 10 years passed and Seraphina returned to the territory with a little Aurielle in her hand, who was at that time around 9 years old.
Her realm was also higher compared to when she was mortal when the Human Emperor took her.
Even though she always felt a little jealous of her sister’s life during those 10 years of Palace.
She was still happy seeing her return to the place where they were born.
As their parents were dead because of a monster tide and they only had each other for support.
Even so she got surprised when she found out that Seraphina had become the lord of the same land.
After that she also helped her with cultivation. But even with all the resources she consumed, she couldn’t reach Bronze Knight, while Seraphina was high at Peak Silver knight.
Soon, she got used to the life of luxury and nobility, where she was attending parties here and there.
Seraphina had warned her many times to stop meeting them, because they were just selfish bastards.
She didn’t know at that time why she held distrust towards them, as to what happened to her in the place.
But Seraphina never told her anything related to the palace.
Later she found out that Seraphina and Aurielle were banished, because Seraphina made some big mistake in the palace, that’s what she heard.
Which she didn’t was truth or false at that time.
Even though they still held their status as the Human Emperor’s wife and Aurielle also held the status of princess,
Though all of that had now became only fake titles.
Which shocked her to the core, as how could this be possible, as how could the Human Emperor allow this.
Still Evelyne couldn’t find more answers related to this.
Soon came the day where calamity struck Blackstone.
Hundreds of thousands of mad beasts and demons came along from the Stormhowl Mountains.
They didn’t know how or when the demons found the way to cross the mountains, but the war of that time, she still remembered.
That how nobody helped them, even after sending hundreds of letters for help to everyone, no one came.
At that she understood why Seraphina distrusted noble’s.
Even though Blackstone repelled the demons, because only weak forces attacked that time,
Still, it cost everything to Blackstone. From that moment, treasury money became less with each day.
Which also affected her noble lifestyle, and she also found out that Blackstone was dying and Seraphina was trying foolishly to hold the territory together.
Then came the worst news, which broke Blackstone’s back.
Seraphina was accused as a traitor, because she let the demon race enter through the Stormhowl Mountains.
As the repelled demons attacked other territories after their unsuccesfull breach at Blackstone, which resulted in thousands of casualties.
Even though soon nobles retaliated and killed all demon invaders,
Seraphina got the tag of traitor, as she couldn’t guard the Stormhowl Mountains border, which came into her territory.
Many voices from the palace officials rose, that Seraphina’s territory was safe because she colluded with demons and let them enter the east side.
No one supported her or defended her. So she was sentenced to life imprisonment, because royalties couldn’t be executed.
Even if she was not born royalty, while Aurielle’s princess status was also removed.
All this time, the Human Emperor did not defend them even once.
Seeing all these, Evelyne became a mentally unstable, which resulted in many corrupted officials entering the territory.
And she couldn’t even properly take care of Aurielle, who was growing without her mother.
So Evelyne chose the road to gamble, to make money, so maybe she could protect the territory which was dying.
And on this, Roland Ashenford helped her a lot.
Although she was not foolish to believe that Roland was helping her completely out of sympathy, she needed help.
So she started attending parties more, which had different gambles among the nobles. Sometimes she won, sometimes she wouldn’t.
She didn’t know when, but she became addicted and even started embezzling the money which was necessary for the territory’s survival.
And today she was regretting all those.
As before, never ever had Aurielle looked at her with those eyes, which only held respect for her.
"Maybe I deserve this." She whispered those words, while imagining the life she had when both her sister and she, were happy with their little house.
At least they were together.
"Seraphina, I miss you." She whispered, as her eyes became moist.
Because when Seraphina was present, she always able to prevent her to become lost.
Only after Seraphina was gone completely did she find how dependent she was on her big sister.
"I miss you, big sister..."

chapters.title: Chapter 195: The Colossal Gate And The Fated One
paragraphs: "Sigh."
Luke walked through the hallways alone. Earlier, after Evelyne’s encounter, Aurielle’s mood had become worse.
So he tried to calm her down, but to no avail.
"I hope she will talk with Evelyne and settle everything." He whispered those words, as he didn’t want Aurielle to feel guilty.
If by mistake she took any decision which she would end up regretting later.
As he was just thinking that—
WHOOSH!
The original Luke, clad in the Valzareth Armor, suddenly teleported beside him.
The very next moment, the clone dissolved into darkness and merged with Luke’s shadow, leaving only the original Luke standing in its place.
Then he brought out the Whispering Tide Conch, before telling Osric and Kai to take care of the territory, as he was going somewhere and would return by the morning.
"Understood My Lord." Both of their voices came from the artifact, before it became quiet again.
"I hope I will deal with it fast." Luke muttered worriedly, as anything could happen in his absence.
[Completing this quest soon would also make you stronger fast.] Then the system’s voice also came, which strengthened Luke’s resolve to complete this quest now.
"Okay." With that he teleported a few more times, before completely leaving the vicinity of Blackstone Highlands.
And none of the citizens, even the four mid-golden knight rank beings of Association building, noticed this.
After finding that he was in a mountain area filled with forest, he transformed into the faceless titan.

Which caused the lone Luke clone, who had been patrolling the territory while eliminating every beast and invader, to glitch for a brief moment before dissolving into darkness and merging back into the void.
"Sylvarion."
Luke didn’t pay it any further attention. Instead, he fully transformed into his Winged Titan form, intending to locate the temple from the skies.
FWOOOSH!
With a single powerful flap of his wings, he shot high into the sky.
A few minutes later, he finally found the temple’s location. It was hidden nearly 50 kilometers away from the Ashveil Trade Route and approximately 700 kilometers from Blackstone Territory.
There, he saw a colossal boulder that resembled a small hill.
"No wonder..."
"No one was ever able to find this," Luke muttered with an enlightened expression.
The massive boulder blended perfectly with the surrounding landscape, appearing no different from a natural formation. Nothing about it hinted that something was hidden beneath it.
Tuk! Tuk!

He tapped its surface a few times and quickly realized just how sturdy it was. The rock was tough enough that it would require at least Silver Knight-level strength just to leave a mark on its surface.
"Well, I can’t make that much noise."
With that, he returned to his normal form before summoning Valzareth once again. Using its teleportation ability, he instantly appeared beneath the massive boulder.
Underground complete darkness greeted him.
However, it didn’t affect his vision in the slightest.
"A tunnel..." Luke muttered as he looked down.
A long circular tunnel stretched into the depths, with a spiral staircase embedded along its inner wall.
It descended so far that even he couldn’t see where it ended.
"Well then, let’s find out where it leads."
With a smile on his face, Luke leaped straight into the abyss.
While still in mid-air, he transformed into his Nyx form, taking advantage of the Titan’s superior physique.
THUD!
He crashed onto the ground with a deafening impact.
The surrounding floor instantly cracked apart, results fractures spreading outward like a giant spiderweb.
Luke paid little attention to the impact behind him.
His gaze was completely drawn to the colossal gate standing before him.
It was utterly plain with no carvings and symbols.
Yet its sheer existence sent an indescribable chill through him.
The gate towered nearly one kilometer into the darkness, spanning almost five hundred meters across, disappearing into the surrounding stone like it had always belonged there.
Luke slowly looked around.
The ceiling...
The walls...
Everything was solid mountain rock.
It was as though someone had hollowed out the heart of an entire mountain... solely to imprison whatever lay beyond this silent gate.
He couldn’t even identify the material.
Then a crazy thought came into his mind, "Can I store this after cutting it down?"
Luke stared at the massive gate, already imagining it standing at the entrance of Blackstone Territory, turning his domain’s entrance into something far more majestic.
[Luke, the hardness of this gate is beyond your current understanding. Even with your current mastery of Physical Severance, you cannot cut it.]
The system’s voice carried a faint mocking tone, as if it was amused by his idea.
Luke’s expression froze.
For a moment, he simply stared at the gate.
A material that even his severance ability couldn’t cut?
Just what exactly was this thing made of?
But before his shock could deepen-
CRAAAAAAACK...
The colossal gate trembled.
Dust and fragments of ancient stone fell from above as the impossible structure slowly began to move.
GGRRRRRRRNNNN...
CREEEEEEAAAAAAAK...
The sound echoed throughout the underground part.
It was not merely the sound of a gate opening.
It sounded like an ancient existence, sleeping for countless years, finally awakening.
For several minutes, that terrifying noise was the only thing that filled the cavern.
Then-
Silence.
A silence so deep that even Luke could hear his own breathing.
Until finally...
A deep voice emerged from beyond the gate.
The voice that belonged to something ancient.
"Another one?"
The words carried no anger. Instead, there was curiosity... and perhaps even a trace of expectation.
As if the being behind the gate had been waiting for someone to arrive.
Hearing this, Luke’s eyes became wary and he peered inside. But this time, he couldn’t see inside.
The darkness present there seemed to reject his vision.
Which increased his wariness to another level.
’It’s really Peak Bronze difficulty?’ And he became doubtful.
’Let’s try another method.’ Finding he couldn’t see inside, he summoned his clone, then sent it inside.
Though, before the clone could even cross the gate, the voice came again.
"Huh? Why are you sending your clone?"
Luke’s eyes narrowed at this. ’He can see outside the gate? while I can’t.’
Still, he ordered the clone to go inside. But then something surprising happened.
The clone couldn’t cross the gate boundary at all, like an invisible wall was blocking its way.
"It’s futile kid."
"Only the fated one could enter inside." The voice said this.
In the voice, Luke could feel its amusement, which was directed toward his futile attempt.
’System, are you sure this is the right place?’ So with a worried face Luke asked the system.
As this whole place seemed to be becoming weirder by each passing moment.
[Luke, this is the right place.]
Afterward, the system even told him that his life would not be lost here, so he could go inside.
Which somewhat calmed him down.
’Let’s do it, Luke.’ So he gathered his courage, before stepping inside, and the clone disappeared the next moment.
"Huh!"
Luke’s eyes widened the moment he saw what lay beyond the gate.
The scene before him completely overturned his expectations.
The interior of the temple was not a dark, forgotten ruin as he had imagined.
Instead, it was illuminated by thousands of old wall lamps, their soft light spreading throughout the enormous chamber and pushing back the endless darkness.
The vast hall stretched very far ahead. And at the very far end...
A statue present.
A colossal statue of a 100-foot-tall giant sat silently upon the ground, its massive body unmoving as if it had been watching over this place for countless ages.
Luke took a slow, deep breath.
Despite his confidence, the atmosphere here was different.
Filled with strangely oppressive aura.
After calming himself, he slowly began walking forward.
Step by step, his footsteps echoed throughout the empty temple.
However, as Luke continued walking forward, his body suddenly rippled.
A strange sensation spread through him.
Before he could react, three figures emerged from his body, stepping into the ancient temple.
"What?!"
Luke instantly retreated several steps, his instincts kicking in.
His hand tightened around Voidfang as he raised the sword, his gaze becoming cautious while he stared at the three unknown figures before him.
But in the very next moment, his expression froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: The Hero Summoning Connection With The Three Titans
paragraphs: Confusion replaced his wariness.
"Nyx?"
His eyes moved to the first figure.
"Caelith?"
Then to the second.
"Myrkhal?"
A strange silence filled the ancient temple.
Because the three beings standing before him were none other than the Titans he had transformed into.
The three forms that belonged to him. Yet somehow, they were now standing before him as independent existences.
But right now, their appearances were completely different from their usual tiny, fairy-like forms.
Nyx had grown to around six feet tall, the same height as Luke.
However, his entire body was no longer physical.
It was composed entirely of swirling darkness, an existence formed from pure Void Energy that distorted the space around him.
Then there was Caelith.
Her entire body burned like a miniature sun, radiating intense heat and golden flames. Like Nyx, she had also taken a humanoid form, standing at the same height as Luke.
And then...
Myrkhal.
Luke stared at him for a few seconds.
"Why are you still the same even in this form?"
The words escaped his mouth unconsciously.
Because unlike the other two, Myrkhal, the Faceless Titan, looked almost exactly the same.
His body remained pure white.
His face remained completely blank.
There were no eyes.
No nose.
No features whatsoever.
Even the strange smiling mouth that Luke often saw was nowhere to be found.
Yet...
Myrkhal slowly turned toward him.
And then he smiled.
Somehow, despite having no face and no mouth.
Luke could clearly feel that Myrkhal was smiling at him.
’No wonder even reality itself becomes confused around him.’
Luke shook his head with a strange expression.
He had heard those words from Nyx before, but seeing Myrkhal’s pysical existence firsthand made him understand exactly what Nyx meant.
"Nyx. Caelith." Luke looked at the two Titans in front of him.
"You two can exist like this?" A hint of disbelief appeared on his face.
"And neither of you ever told me about it?" He muttered those words while slowly moving toward them, his eyes still scanning the surroundings cautiously.
He was searching for the source of the voice from earlier.
But no matter where he looked, nothing appeared.
The only thing present inside the massive temple was the colossal statue sitting in the distance.
However...
Luke’s expression became slightly serious when he looked at it.
The statue was covered in an unknown darkness.
A layer of shadow completely surrounded it, preventing his vision from penetrating through.
Even his Titan senses couldn’t see what was hidden beneath it.
Meanwhile, Nyx continued looking around with a confused expression.
He remembered being asleep inside Luke’s body all this time.
Then suddenly-
The force that had been suppressing their consciousness disappeared.
It was as if an invisible chain binding them had been broken.
Taking advantage of that moment, Nyx created an elemental body for himself and emerged.
The same thing happened with Caelith and even Myrkhal.
"I don’t know." Nyx answered honestly.
Caelith silently nodded beside him, showing that she was equally unaware.
As for Myrkhal...
He simply smiled again.
Luke stared at him for a moment.
’What a weirdo.’
He finally shifted his gaze away from Myrkhal.
At least before this, when Myrkhal only had that strange smiling mouth, he wasn’t this confusing.
But now a faceless Titan smiling without a face was somehow even more unsettling.
"But I think I understand why we have been sleeping so much recently." Nyx muttered as he looked around the ancient temple with curiosity.
Caelith also nodded, as if she had already reached the same conclusion.
"Valtharion was suppressing us."
Nyx turned his attention back toward Luke and continued explaining his theory.
"Before this, I didn’t know how, your system thing was brought us here."
"But now..."
He narrowed his eyes slightly.
"It seems to be following the same method that the gods and goddesses of this world used."
Luke raised an eyebrow upon hearing this.
’The same method as those beings?’
His mind immediately connected the pieces.
’Hero summoning!’
His eyes widened slightly in surprise.
If Nyx was right, then the System’s method of bringing him to this world was not something unique.
It was something that had been done before.
By the gods and goddesses themselves.
However...
Silence.
No notification appeared.
The System remained completely silent, leaving Luke with only Nyx’s theory.
Though Nyx continued explaining.
"Even though I still don’t know what happened to our original bodies."
He glanced toward Luke.
"Because you didn’t inherit even a fraction of our true power."
"But leave that aside for now."
Nyx’s expression became more serious.
"The important thing is... our souls still belong to a higher level of existence."
"A level even greater than the gods this world’s people worship."
Luke’s expression slightly changed.
"Your system suppressed the level of our souls before placing them inside your body.
"As for why." Nyx shook his head.
"I don’t know either."
"However, Valtharion could still sense our presence within you."
His voice became heavier.
"That is why it continued suppressing our already weakened souls all this time."
Luke remained silent.
He listened carefully from beginning to end, absorbing every word Nyx said.
But this revelation was something he had never expected.
Until now, he had always assumed that he was simply borrowing the power of their Titan bodies.
Yet, the more he thought about it the more he felt, that something had always strange.
Even after becoming a Bronze Knight, he had expected the power he received from them to grow far more significantly.
But it never did.
It was as if something was constantly limiting the connection between them.
As he was still only receiving a 5x stats multiplier, meaning he couldn’t access their true Titan-level physical attributes.
Other than their abilities, he was unable to use their actual strength.
’System, tell—’
"Hmm... only one person should have entered."
"Then how did four of you come in?"
Before Luke could even finish his question, the unfamiliar voice echoed again.
However, this time-
He knew exactly where it came from.
His gaze slowly shifted toward the massive statue.
"The statue..." Luke muttered under his breath, his expression becoming cautious as he stared at the ancient figure.
Meanwhile, Nyx, Caelith, and Myrkhal simply looked at the statue with curiosity.
They showed no fear.
"Are they not afraid?" Luke shook his head, removing the unnecessary thought from his mind.
This was not the time to worry about their strange behavior.
Because the statue spoke once again.
"Are their powers becoming weaker?"
The deep voice echoed throughout the temple.
Then, in the next moment-
The endless darkness covering the statue’s body began to move.
Like a living shadow, it was slowly pulled inward, being absorbed into the statue itself.
As the darkness vanished, the true appearance hidden beneath it was finally revealed.
*A 100-foot-tall muscular stone statue.*
Even while sitting, its enormous body reached a terrifying height, making Luke realize just how massive this being would be, when he it stood.
However, its face immediately caught his attention.
Or rather...
The lack of one.
The statue’s face had been completely destroyed.
It looked as if someone had repeatedly struck it countless times, beating it until its original appearance became impossible to recognize.
The entire surface was covered in deep cracks.
Chunks of stone were missing.
Fragments had crumbled away.
Whatever identity this giant once possessed. It had been deliberately erased.
Luke stared silently at the damaged face.

chapters.title: Chapter 197: The Previous Hero Of Light
paragraphs: ’Holy sh*t...’ Luke’s pupils contracted as he stared at the statue’s ruined face.
Which had been deliberately obliterated.
Meanwhile, Nyx and Caelith exchanged surprised glances.
They could clearly sense it.
The unmistakable bloodline of a Titan flowed from the stone giant before them.
The ancient stone Titan noticed their reactions.
Somehow.
Despite having no visible eyes capable of seeing them.
"Now then..." His deep, ancient voice rumbled through the Temple.
"Where was I?" As he spoke, the colossal stone hand that had been resting peacefully upon his knee slowly rose.
The movement was unhurried. Yet every inch it traveled made the temple tremble.
He brought his massive hand to his shattered face.
Grrrk...
Thick stone fingers slowly rubbed across the broken remains, as though trying to remember a face that no longer existed.
All the while, his ruined head remained turned toward the four of them.
Somehow...
It felt as though he was looking directly at them.
’System, what the hell is this thing?!’ Luke shouted inwardly.
In response, the System merely gave him a shrug.
[Isn’t that why you’ve come here?]
[To find out who he is?]
Hearing the System’s utterly nonchalant reply, Luke’s face immediately darkened.
’Find out?’
’You want me to ask a giant that could turn me into a paste with a single finger?’
’Hell nah!’
Fortunately, the ancient stone giant continued speaking before Luke had to say anything.
"You are not four." His ancient voice echoed through the silent temple.
Slowly, the colossal Titan leaned forward.
The movement alone caused the ground beneath them to groan.
His shattered face first turned toward the Faceless Titan.
He remained silent for a brief moment.
Then his broken head slowly shifted until it was facing Luke.
Even without eyes, Luke felt as though every secret within him had been laid bare before that ancient gaze.
"You..." The ancient stone giant’s voice rumbled through the temple.
"You are the one carrying them."
He paused.
"Or-"
The giant slowly fell silent.
His enormous stone hand rose toward the cavern’s ceiling.
Then, to Luke’s complete confusion. He began counting on his fingers.
One.
Two.
Three...
’Is he? counting stars?’ Luke blinked, utterly baffled by the giant’s strange behavior.
Meanwhile.
Myrkhal paid no attention whatsoever.
He had already wandered away, leisurely strolling around the enormous temple as though it were his own home.
Luke’s eyelid twitched.
’Do you realize that thing could turn you into paste with a flick?’
Fortunately nothing happened.
The stone giant merely watched Myrkhal in silence before his ancient voice echoed through the temple once again.
"Interesting!" This time, the stone giant’s voice boomed through the temple with far greater force.
BOOOOOOM!
The entire temple trembled. Yet, despite the overwhelming vibration. Not a single grain of dust fell from the ceiling.
Luke’s eyes narrowed.
’So the entire temple. It’s built from the same material as that colossal gate.’
Otherwise, the cavern should have collapsed long ago under a voice like that.
Meanwhile, the giant remained completely still.
His ruined face was pointed directly toward Luke.
Or perhaps.
Not Luke himself.
’My heart?’ Luke immediately dismissed the thought.
’No-’
’My soul.’
Somehow, he felt the giant wasn’t looking at his body at all.
It was looking at something much deeper.
After waiting a moment and sensing no hostility from the ancient being—at least, not yet—Luke decided to speak.
He unconsciously lowered his voice.
"May I know... who you are?"
Silence.
The stone giant didn’t answer immediately.
Instead, he slowly raised one massive hand and scratched the side of his shattered head.
His posture. Surprisingly...
Looked genuinely confused.
"Me?"
"I don’t know." The stone giant simply shrugged.
Luke froze.
’How can you not know your own na—’
His thoughts came to an abrupt halt.
His pupils contracted.
The quest description flashed through his mind.
*The One whose true name was struck from history... because even those who ruled eternity feared to speak it.*
Luke slowly swallowed.
’So that’s what it meant...’
It wasn’t that the giant refused to reveal his name.
He genuinely didn’t remember it.
Realizing this, Luke immediately changed his question.
"Then."
"What should we call you, sir?"
The stone giant tilted his shattered head ever so slightly.
He remained silent for a long moment before speaking.
"Even though I no longer remember my true name." His ancient voice echoed softly.
"But I still remember some of my titles." Before continuing, he slowly turned his broken face toward Myrkhal.
The Faceless Titan was currently...
Bathing his face in the flame of one of the ancient wall lamps.
Luke’s eyelid twitched.
’That’s not an ordinary flame.’
Yet Myrkhal was treating it like warm bathwater.
Beside him, Nyx and Caelith merely sighed and shook their heads, already accustomed to Myrkhal’s incomprehensible behavior.
The stone giant watched him for a brief moment. Then he slowly turned back toward Luke.
His shattered face remained unreadable.
"I have borne many titles throughout the ages."
"You may call me by any one of them."
The ancient giant paused...
Before revealing the one title.
*THE ORIGIN TITAN*
The moment those words left its mouth, the whole temple seemed to shake, like they were fearing...
Fearing that even this title could bring back the horror which the temple or the prison had contained within it.
After a few moments, the shaking finally stopped and Luke also took a breath of relief.
’What the f*ck!’
’But it also feels cool.’ Luke first cursed, before thinking that having this title could also be cool.
Just think, whenever his name was introduced with his title, the whole ground would shake, while people would become crazy from this.
[Luke, the girls would not be impressed by this.]
"Ahem." Luke lightly coughed to remove those thoughts, still, he gave an annoyed glare to the System.
Then he looked toward the front, where Nyx and Caelith both had frozen.
’Huh? Frozen?’ Luke became surprised, wondering what happened to them, so he looked toward Myrkhal.
Who was also frozen while bathing in fire.
Seeing this, his eyes became suspicious as he looked toward the stone giant.
Who was actually surprised at seeing Luke standing fine.
"How are you still fine?" its voice filled with curiosity, which made Luke confused.
"Even the previous hero couldn’t stand properly after hearing my title."
But these words made Luke’s eyes wide. ’Previous hero!’
Though the stone giant continued, "Did you get the map from the previous hero?"
The more Luke heard, the more he became confused, but the giant continued, like he was fulfilling his own curiosity.
"Of course, she would have given it to you. After all, you have her blessing on you."
"Blessing?" Luke finally muttered the confused words, because it was getting out of hand.
Since he never met the previous hero, then how could he have a blessing on him?
"Huh? The blessing which will resurrect you once."
’WHAT THE F**K!’ Luke was about to shout out loud, but controlled himself and screamed inside to not disrespect the giant.
’I literally have a revive spell on me and I didn’t even know!’ He shouted inside again, but that made him more confused.
So he asked his question out loud. "Sir, I have not met with any hero that you are talking about."
"And I myself am a hero of light, though a new one." He said those words, but the next words that came out of the giant’s mouth baffled him even more.
"Ahh, she was also a Hero of Light." The giant scratched its head, seemingly trying to remember something.
"Yes, her name was-"
"Lumina Celestia."
’Lumina.’ Luke also froze this time, not because of some spell, but because he knew this name.
How could he not?
When it was the name of the same person who smiled at him when he came to this world.
The same person who married him to his bride.
"The Saintess of the Holy Church."
’Young hero, what’s your name?’ And these words of her were repeating in his mind.
’Young hero...’
"She was the previous hero of light." Luke’s voice, filled with shock, slowly came out.

chapters.title: Chapter 198: The Goddess’s Missing Gift
paragraphs: A few moments later, Luke finally calmed himself.
However...
A question that had bothered him for a long time resurfaced in his mind.
’System.’
’I’m supposed to be the Hero of Light.’
’So why don’t I possess the Light element?’
The question echoed silently within his thoughts.
It had never made sense to him.
From the very moment he arrived in this world, everyone had referred to him as the Hero of Light.
Yet. He couldn’t use Light element. Not even a trace of it.
In the beginning, he had assumed it was because he was too weak.
He believed that once he reached the Body Temper Realm, the Light element would naturally awaken.
But it never did.
Even after all this time. His Aether remained completely neutral.
The only elemental properties he could wield came from his Titan transformations.
When he became Nyx, his Aether took on the characteristics of the Void.
And in his Cosmic Titan form, it carried traces of cosmic energy.
Of course, those weren’t truly his own powers.
They were merely fragments of the Titans Aether characteristics, borrowed through the transformation rather than awakened within himself.
Which only deepened the mystery.
If he truly was the Hero of Light. Then where was his Light?
[Luke, a true Hero is only born after undergoing the Hero Awakening Ceremony.]
[Before that... their body is merely being prepared to contain the element they were chosen to inherit.]
Luke’s eyes widened. ’Hero Awakening Ceremony?’
He had never heard of such a thing. from the Holy Light Church.
However, when he tried asking about hero awakening ceremony. The System remained stubbornly silent.
[Figure that part out yourself.]
It dismissed the question before continuing.
[After completing the Awakening Ceremony.]
[A Hero gains maximum mastery over their designated element.]
[Second only to the god or goddess governing that element.]
Luke’s mind went blank for a moment.
Maximum mastery? From the very moment of awakening?
"That’s crazy!" Unable to hold himself back, Luke blurted it out loud.
Luke’s voice echoed throughout the ancient temple.
His heart couldn’t help but race. If what the System had said was true...
Then after completing the Hero Awakening Ceremony, every Light element would naturally respond to his will.
Even attacks imbued with Light would lose much of their effectiveness against him.
Of course, he would still need to learn Light-based spells and techniques.
But with such a high mastery. That process would be unimaginably easy.
"You... are real." Then Nyx’s voice suddenly broke the silence.
Luke turned toward him.
The usually composed Void Titan was staring at the stone giant with an expression Luke had never seen before.
It was the look of someone witnessing a legend they had believed existed only in myths.
Beside him, Caelith wore the same expression.
She said nothing.
Yet the flames covering her body burned brighter than ever, surging with excitement as if they had sensed the significance of the being before them.
So Luke turned toward Myrkhal, hoping to see at least a hint of surprise on the Faceless Titan’s... well, faceless head.
But how wrong he was.
Luke’s eyelid twitched.
’This menace.’ He couldn’t help but curse inwardly.
Myrkhal was now casually sitting on top of one of the ancient wall lamps, seemingly enjoying the blazing flame beneath him.
It was as if the revelation that the being before them was the Origin Titan wasn’t worth reacting to.
’Just what is his body even made of?’ Luke became genuinely puzzled.
Before Luke could think any further, Nyx spoke again.
His voice carried a mixture of disbelief and awe.
"So it wasn’t just a myth..."
"A single Titan capable of carrying the powers of every Firstborn Titan."
Luke’s breathing hitched.
’A Titan, with every Titan’s power?’ His eyes widened in disbelief.
’That’s insane!’
Every Titan he possessed was already absurdly powerful on its own.
And now he was being told that a single Titan had once possessed all of those powers at the same time.
How was that even possible?
"Nyx..." Luke looked toward the Void Titan.
"Is that really true?"
Before Nyx could answer. Caelith spoke instead.
"Yes." Her gaze remained fixed on the colossal stone giant.
"But that isn’t what made the Origin Titan truly special."
Luke blinked.
A bewildered expression spread across his face.
"...What?"
"A Titan possessing every Firstborn Titan’s authority."
"And you’re telling me that wasn’t the important part?"
Caelith slowly shook her head.
"It was extraordinary."
"But it wasn’t the reason the Origin Titan became a legend."
Her voice grew noticeably heavier.
"The Origin Titan possessed something else."
"Something that shattered the balance of the cosmos itself."
Luke unconsciously held his breath.
Even Nyx remained silent, allowing Caelith to continue.
"That..."
"Is why we believed the Origin Titan was nothing more than a myth.
As Caelith finished speaking, Nyx silently nodded in agreement.
Even Myrkhal slowly turned his head toward the stone giant.
Luke’s eyes narrowed.
’Wait...’
’His head is on fire?’
He blinked twice.
Sometime during the conversation, Myrkhal had somehow managed to set his own head ablaze by continuing to sit inside the ancient lamp’s flame.
Yet. He looked completely unbothered.
If anything, he seemed perfectly content.
’How are you even doing that?’ Luke couldn’t decide whether to be impressed or concerned.
Shaking those thoughts away, he focused on what Caelith had just revealed.
His mind drifted back to the System Quest.
*The One whose true name was struck from history... because even those who ruled eternity feared to speak it.*
Luke’s gaze instinctively shifted toward the Origin Titan’s shattered face.
’No wonder they erased hi—’ His thoughts stopped midway.
He corrected himself.
"Or at least..."
"...they tried to."
He muttered under his breath.
Throughout the entire exchange, the Origin Titan remained silent.
He simply listened.
Then.
The ancient giant slowly nodded. His deep voice echoed across the vast temple.
"And you..." He looked directly at Luke.
"Were sent here to inherit my power."
Silence engulfed the temple.
Then came the next words.
Words that made even Nyx and Caelith stiffen.
"The power Of the Origin Titan."
Luke’s eyebrows rose.
’The power... of the Origin Titan...’
Though the giant titan continued. "And it seems they have failed at the start, when you were summoned."
"Failed?" Luke muttered unconsciously.
Then a forgotten detail resurfaced in his mind.
’The Goddess’s gift.’ From the very beginning, he had been told that every Hero received a divine gift from the Goddess.
Yet. Even after all this time. He had never received one.
His eyes slowly narrowed.
’Then was the SSS-Rank Titan Knight skill given by the System...’
’...or by the Goddess?’
Another thought immediately followed.
’Did the System take the Goddess’s gift...’
’...and simply release it later as a quest reward?’

chapters.title: Chapter 199: The Goddess’s Failed Experiment
paragraphs: The more Luke thought about it. The more suspicious the System seemed.
An expressionless face suddenly appeared before him.
[Luke.]
[You can’t slander me like that.]
Luke coughed awkwardly but didn’t look particularly convinced.
The System continued.
[You never received the Goddess’s gift because the process failed.]
[Her method of creating an Origin Titan was unsuccessful.]
Luke’s eyes widened slightly.
[As for the SSS-Rank Titan Knight.]
[That reward was created by the System.]
[It has nothing to do with the Origin Titan.]
Before Luke could ask another question, the System added,
[And I have already told you before.]
[Every System reward is the highest quality possible for its respective rank.]
[Your SSS-Rank skill is fundamentally different from the Origin Titan’s power.]
[In one aspect... it is even superior.]
Luke blinked.
"Superior?"
[Correct.]
[Because it can evolve.]
The System’s uninterrupted explanation left Luke completely stunned.
He had never expected the Goddess’s gift to have failed.
’Just who the heck was the delivery person!’ Luke couldn’t help but grumble inwardly.
’I’d like to have a few words with that guy.’
After mentally complaining for a while, his thoughts shifted back to his SSS-Rank Titan Knight skill.
Thinking about it objectively. Aside from the System’s habit of imposing ridiculous restrictions.
The skill itself was unbelievably powerful.
More importantly. It could evolve.
That alone placed it beyond almost every ability he had ever heard of.
’Maybe...’ Luke’s lips curled upward.
’One day, after it evolves enough. It might even surpass the Origin Titan.’
His shoulders visibly relaxed.
If even the System claimed the skill possessed greater potential, then perhaps it truly wasn’t inferior.
As though confirming his thoughts, the Origin Titan slowly spoke.
"However, it seems you have received a different kind of gift."
His ancient voice echoed throughout the temple.
"One capable of allowing you to wield the power of Titans."
Luke’s attention immediately snapped back to the giant.
The Origin Titan slowly swept his gaze across Luke. Nyx. Caelith.
And finally Myrkhal.
Then the ancient giant opened his mouth once more.
And uttered something Luke never could have anticipated.
"And it seems your body is too weak right now."
"But at Silver Rank, you will merge with them."
The origin titan said with curious tone. Because he could feel, that merging was already happening.
But something was stoping it from happening. what he didn’t knew.
Luke’s heart skipped a beat as his eyes widened with anticipation.
’Finally...’
’I’ll be able to use their real Titan strength instead of just borrowing fragments of it.’
However.
Before his imagination could run any further, the System immediately poured cold water over his excitement.
[Don’t get too excited.]
Luke’s smile stiffened.
[You will only inherit the amount of power your current body can withstand.]
[Your bloodline, body, mind, and soul will all evolve gradually.]
[At your current Silver Knight level.]
[They can only support the lowest stage of a true Titan bloodline.]
Luke’s expression twitched.
The System continued mercilessly.
[In other words...]
[You will become the weakest kind of true Titan.]
[A Titan that every genuine Titan would look down upon.]
Luke’s face darkened.
[Fortunately, that won’t remain the case forever.]
[Every breakthrough in your cultivation will further strengthen your body, mind, and soul.]
[As that happens, your Titan bloodline will continue evolving, allowing you to inherit increasingly greater portions of their true power.]
Luke nodded slightly.
That part, at least, sounded reasonable.
Then the System added one final sentence.
[Right now, though... you’re basically a newborn Titan.]
Luke’s eyelid twitched.
’That last part was completely unnecessary.’
He silently cursed the System.
Somehow.
It always managed to remind him just how weak he currently was.
’Wait a sec.’ Then his expression turned to worry, as he looked toward Nyx, Caelith and Myrkhal... nah, not Myrkhal.
"What would happen to all of you after merging?" He asked this important question.
’Would they die for real?’ Luke thought with a sad expression.
Because even though he didn’t spend much time with them, all the moments were precious to him.
As they were his companions, teachers and support. He could not describe it in words.
Seeing Luke’s sad expression, Nyx shook his head, while Caelith just smiled, before telling him.
"Luke, our universe is already destroyed and we were just imprisoned." She shook her head in regret.
Since they couldn’t protect their home, while their enemies imprisoned them because they couldn’t die.
But after their bodies merged with Luke, they would die for real, at least on a body level.
Still, their consciousness would remain, which she mentioned to Luke.
"I will get revenge for you against the being who did this to you." Luke said with resolve, but Caelith just shook her head.
"Your world has its own problems, focus on them." With that, they became quiet and looked toward the Stone giant.
Seeing their talk had finished, he nodded, before saying. "Since you are a hero seeking my fragment."
"You have to prove that you are worthy." His deep, heavy voice came serious this time, which clearly indicated: fail and no fragment for you.
Luke nodded and asked, "Does every hero come after your fragment?"
The Origin Titan shook his head in denial. "Only the hero of light has come here."
"Also, the world holds many secrets and many beings which were no less weak than me in my prime."
"Though, with different characteristics."
"So maybe those heroes are after them."
As the final words left the Origin Titan’s mouth, he slowly rose to his feet.
RUMMMMMBLE!!
The entire temple shook violently.
At the same time, countless ancient runes carved across the walls, pillars, and ceiling blazed with a brilliant azure light, illuminating the vast underground world.
Seeing this Luke narrowed his eyes, realizing the runes weren’t restraining the giant but strengthening the temple itself, allowing it to withstand the Origin Titan’s upcoming attack.
When the giant finally stood upright, Luke instinctively raised his head.
Higher and Higher.
Until he could finally see the top.
A thousand-foot-tall stone Titan stood before him, making even the colossal gate seem insignificant.
"So... big," Luke muttered, his mouth hanging open.
The Origin Titan looked down at the tiny Hero beneath him before speaking in his deep, ancient voice.
"Prove your strength by breaking this body."
"You will have three attempts."
"You may use any method at your disposal."
There wasn’t even a hint of arrogance in his tone—only absolute confidence. In his eyes, no matter what Luke chose to do, the outcome would remain the same.
Failure.
Luke couldn’t even argue with the challenge.
After all, he had no idea what realm the Origin Titan actually belonged to.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: First Origin Fragment - The Trial of Strength
paragraphs: He knew the quest difficulty was only Peak Bronze Knight, yet the being standing before him felt infinitely beyond that.
Taking a deep breath, Luke spoke honestly.
"Sir, I’m only an Early Bronze Knight. Your realm is far too high."
The Origin Titan paused and looked directly into Luke’s eyes, waiting for him to continue.
"So this isn’t exactly fair," Luke said with an awkward smile. "At the very least, you should suppress yourself to my realm."
Having said that, he silently hoped the ancient Titan would accept the suggestion.
Instead...
The Origin Titan tilted his head in confusion.
"Huh?"
He sounded genuinely puzzled.
"The power released by my fragment is already limited to the Peak Bronze realm."
"Specifically..."
"The Peak Bronze realm of the strongest Titan species born in this universe."
Luke froze.
’...What?’ His mind went blank.
If that was only Peak Bronze.
Then that meant there existed Titans who, despite being only Peak Bronze, already possessed bodies nearly one thousand feet tall.
Just how monstrous were Titans supposed to be?
Before Luke could recover from the shock, the Origin Titan continued.
"And this body is made from nothing more than ordinary stone." The Origin Titan calmly tapped his chest.
"My fragment merely refined it to the limits of a Peak Bronze Titan."
He paused before adding,
"So I am already being fair."
"If I were to use the true physical strength of my original body at the Peak Bronze realm..."
"You would be facing a Titan at least ten thousand feet tall."
Luke stood there in silence.
"...I take it back."
"You’re being extremely fair."
The moment he heard ten thousand feet, every thought of complaining vanished.
Taking a deep breath, Luke slowly raised his hand.
"Caelith Ascension."
The words echoed throughout the temple.
A brilliant radiance erupted from his body.
His physique rapidly expanded as his enchanted clothes automatically adjusted to fit his growing frame.
His hair lengthened, turning a brilliant golden blonde, while streaks of violet starlight flowed through it like living streams of cosmic energy.
His eyes transformed into miniature galaxies, with moon and planets revolving within them as his Cosmic System quietly rotated in their depths.
Moments later, a fourteen-foot-tall Cosmic Heart Titan stood inside the ancient temple.
"Interesting..." The Origin Titan’s tone carried genuine curiosity.
As he could sense an unfamiliar authority surrounding Luke.
It was the aura of a Warden.
However, Luke was still far too weak to draw out its true potential, allowing the Origin Titan to perceive only a faint trace of that power.
Even so...
The fact that a human could partially merge with a pure bloodline Titan was remarkable enough.
For the first time, a hint of anticipation appeared within the Origin Titan.
Could he actually overcome this trial?
With that thought, his expression became serious.
"Remember this."
His deep voice echoed through the temple.
"My power..."
"Or rather, my existence..."
"...was divided into thirteen different forms."
Luke’s expression instantly turned solemn.
Nyx, Caelith, and even Myrkhal stopped what they were doing, their full attention fixed on the Origin Titan as they carefully listened to every word that followed.
"The first fragment embodies Strength," the Origin Titan said, his voice echoing through the vast temple. "That is the fragment you are facing now."
"As for the second fragment and those beyond it."
"Each possesses a different authority."
"A different method."
"And a different trial."
He paused.
His ruined face slowly turned toward the empty darkness above, as though searching for something beyond the temple itself.
’...Strange’
For the first time since Luke had arrived, genuine confusion appeared in the Origin Titan’s voice.
He couldn’t sense the other fragments. as they had completely vanished from his perception.
That had never happened before.
Did they discover another method?
If so...
Why didn’t they begin with me, the first fragment?
The Origin Titan fell silent, seemingly lost in ancient memories.
Luke, Nyx, Caelith, and even Myrkhal waited patiently, not daring to interrupt.
After a long moment, the giant slowly lowered his head.
The curiosity in his voice disappeared.
Replaced by absolute seriousness.
"Listen carefully."
The atmosphere inside the temple instantly became heavy.
"What I am about to say. You must never forget."
Luke instinctively straightened his posture.
"The moment you obtain my fragment those beings will realize that one of the thirteen fragments has disappeared."
Silence.
The words echoed through the temple like a death sentence.
Luke’s heart skipped a beat.
His mind immediately recalled the quest description.
The beings...
The ones who had imprisoned even the Origin Titan.
A chill ran down his spine.
The Origin Titan paid no attention to the fear on Luke’s face and continued in the same calm, heavy tone.
"Although they cannot directly locate my fragments."
"You must still remain vigilant."
"Be wary of their methods."
"Compared to them, the methods used on Valtharion are simple."
"Their ways are so mysterious that you will rarely encounter anything similar in this world."
He paused for a moment before revealing another truth.
"Not all of my fragments rest on Valtharion."
"One day, you will have to leave this world and venture into the worlds beyond."
Luke’s expression stiffened.
But the Origin Titan’s tone suddenly became much more serious.
"However..."
"Remember this."
"At any cost..."
He deliberately repeated himself.
"At any cost..."
"Do not leave Valtharion until you have become the strongest being upon it."
The weight behind those words was enough to make even Nyx and Caelith remain silent.
"Understood?"
Luke met the giant’s gaze and nodded without hesitation.
"I understand."
The Origin Titan gave a slow nod before continuing.
"I have told you all of this because..."
"If, by some miracle, you succeed in destroying this body."
He glanced at his own stone form.
"Then the fragment sealed within it."
"And the consciousness I have left behind here."
"Will both disappear forever."
With that, the Origin Titan slowly crossed his colossal arms across his chest.
RUMMMBLE!!
The movement alone shook the entire temple.
The giant then lowered his shattered face and looked directly at Luke.
A faint trace of anticipation could be felt in his ancient voice.
"Come."
"Show me the strength..."
"That the new generation’s Hero of Light possesses!"
BOOOOOM!!
His thunderous voice exploded throughout the underground world, the deafening sound slamming into Luke like a physical force.
Luke instinctively grimaced, feeling his eardrums nearly burst from the overwhelming roar.
Even so...
A smile slowly appeared on his face.
If this was the trial to obtain the Origin Titan’s fragment. Then he would conquer it.

sentences.text: He knew the quest difficulty was only Peak Bronze Knight, yet the being standing before him felt infinitely beyond that.
Taking a deep breath, Luke spoke honestly.
"Sir, I’m only an Early Bronze Knight.
Your realm is far too high."
The Origin Titan paused and looked directly into Luke’s eyes, waiting for him to continue.
"So this isn’t exactly fair," Luke said with an awkward smile.
"At the very least, you should suppress yourself to my realm."
Having said that, he silently hoped the ancient Titan would accept the suggestion.
Instead...
The Origin Titan tilted his head in confusion.
"Huh?"
He sounded genuinely puzzled.
"The power released by my fragment is already limited to the Peak Bronze realm."
"Specifically..."
"The Peak Bronze realm of the strongest Titan species born in this universe."
Luke froze.
’...What?’ His mind went blank.
If that was only Peak Bronze.
Then that meant there existed Titans who, despite being only Peak Bronze, already possessed bodies nearly one thousand feet tall.
Just how monstrous were Titans supposed to be?
Before Luke could recover from the shock, the Origin Titan continued.
"And this body is made from nothing more than ordinary stone." The Origin Titan calmly tapped his chest.
"My fragment merely refined it to the limits of a Peak Bronze Titan."
He paused before adding,
"So I am already being fair."
"If I were to use the true physical strength of my original body at the Peak Bronze realm..."
"You would be facing a Titan at least ten thousand feet tall."
Luke stood there in silence.
"...I take it back."
"You’re being extremely fair."
The moment he heard ten thousand feet, every thought of complaining vanished.
Taking a deep breath, Luke slowly raised his hand.
"Caelith Ascension."
The words echoed throughout the temple.
A brilliant radiance erupted from his body.
His physique rapidly expanded as his enchanted clothes automatically adjusted to fit his growing frame.
His hair lengthened, turning a brilliant golden blonde, while streaks of violet starlight flowed through it like living streams of cosmic energy.
His eyes transformed into miniature galaxies, with moon and planets revolving within them as his Cosmic System quietly rotated in their depths.
Moments later, a fourteen-foot-tall Cosmic Heart Titan stood inside the ancient temple.
"Interesting..." The Origin Titan’s tone carried genuine curiosity.
As he could sense an unfamiliar authority surrounding Luke.
It was the aura of a Warden.
However, Luke was still far too weak to draw out its true potential, allowing the Origin Titan to perceive only a faint trace of that power.
Even so...
The fact that a human could partially merge with a pure bloodline Titan was remarkable enough.
For the first time, a hint of anticipation appeared within the Origin Titan.
Could he actually overcome this trial?
With that thought, his expression became serious.
"Remember this."
His deep voice echoed through the temple.
"My power..."
"Or rather, my existence..."
"...was divided into thirteen different forms."
Luke’s expression instantly turned solemn.
Nyx, Caelith, and even Myrkhal stopped what they were doing, their full attention fixed on the Origin Titan as they carefully listened to every word that followed.
"The first fragment embodies Strength," the Origin Titan said, his voice echoing through the vast temple.
"That is the fragment you are facing now."
"As for the second fragment and those beyond it."
"Each possesses a different authority."
"A different method."
"And a different trial."
He paused.
His ruined face slowly turned toward the empty darkness above, as though searching for something beyond the temple itself.
’...Strange’
For the first time since Luke had arrived, genuine confusion appeared in the Origin Titan’s voice.
He couldn’t sense the other fragments. as they had completely vanished from his perception.
That had never happened before.
Did they discover another method?
If so...
Why didn’t they begin with me, the first fragment?
The Origin Titan fell silent, seemingly lost in ancient memories.
Luke, Nyx, Caelith, and even Myrkhal waited patiently, not daring to interrupt.
After a long moment, the giant slowly lowered his head.
The curiosity in his voice disappeared.
Replaced by absolute seriousness.
"Listen carefully."
The atmosphere inside the temple instantly became heavy.
"What I am about to say.
You must never forget."
Luke instinctively straightened his posture.
"The moment you obtain my fragment those beings will realize that one of the thirteen fragments has disappeared."
Silence.
The words echoed through the temple like a death sentence.
Luke’s heart skipped a beat.
His mind immediately recalled the quest description.
The beings...
The ones who had imprisoned even the Origin Titan.
A chill ran down his spine.
The Origin Titan paid no attention to the fear on Luke’s face and continued in the same calm, heavy tone.
"Although they cannot directly locate my fragments."
"You must still remain vigilant."
"Be wary of their methods."
"Compared to them, the methods used on Valtharion are simple."
"Their ways are so mysterious that you will rarely encounter anything similar in this world."
He paused for a moment before revealing another truth.
"Not all of my fragments rest on Valtharion."
"One day, you will have to leave this world and venture into the worlds beyond."
Luke’s expression stiffened.
But the Origin Titan’s tone suddenly became much more serious.
"However..."
"Remember this."
"At any cost..."
He deliberately repeated himself.
"At any cost..."
"Do not leave Valtharion until you have become the strongest being upon it."
The weight behind those words was enough to make even Nyx and Caelith remain silent.
"Understood?"
Luke met the giant’s gaze and nodded without hesitation.
"I understand."
The Origin Titan gave a slow nod before continuing.
"I have told you all of this because..."
"If, by some miracle, you succeed in destroying this body."
He glanced at his own stone form.
"Then the fragment sealed within it."
"And the consciousness I have left behind here."
"Will both disappear forever."
With that, the Origin Titan slowly crossed his colossal arms across his chest.
RUMMMBLE!!
The movement alone shook the entire temple.
The giant then lowered his shattered face and looked directly at Luke.
A faint trace of anticipation could be felt in his ancient voice.
"Come."
"Show me the strength..."
"That the new generation’s Hero of Light possesses!"
BOOOOOM!!
His thunderous voice exploded throughout the underground world, the deafening sound slamming into Luke like a physical force.
Luke instinctively grimaced, feeling his eardrums nearly burst from the overwhelming roar.
Even so...
A smile slowly appeared on his face.
If this was the trial to obtain the Origin Titan’s fragment.
Then he would conquer it.
